subtopicFull: General Physics
front: Define "field".
back: A field is a physical quantity that has a value at every point in space, and sometimes also at every moment in time. The value of a field can be a scalar, such as temperature, or a vector, such as gravitational field strength or electric field strength. A field describes how an influence, such as gravity or electromagnetism, extends through space and affects objects placed there. This allows physicists to model interactions without saying that objects act instantly on each other at a distance.
frontZh: 定义“场”。
backZh: 场是一个在空间中每一点都有数值的物理量，有时也在每一时刻都有数值。 场的值可以是标量，例如温度；也可以是矢量，例如引力场强或电场强度。 场描述一种影响（例如引力或电磁作用）如何延伸到空间中，并影响放在其中的物体。 这使物理学家可以建立相互作用的模型，而不需要说物体会隔着距离瞬间作用于彼此。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 1: Exploring & designing
front: What is an independent variable?
back: An independent variable is a variable that is changed on purpose in order to observe the effects of the change.
frontZh: 什么是自变量？
backZh: 自变量是为了观察变化带来的影响而被有意改变的变量。
frontZh: 什么是自变量？
backZh: 一个自变量是为了观察变化的影响而故意更改的变量。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 1: Exploring & designing
front: What is a dependent variable?
back: A dependent variable is a variable that changes in response to changing the independent variable. The effects of this change are predicted, observed, and measured.
frontZh: 什么是因变量？
backZh: 因变量是随着自变量改变而发生变化的变量。这种变化的结果会被预测、观察和测量。
frontZh: 什么是因变量？
backZh: 一个因变量是随着自变量的变化而变化的变量。这种变化的影响是可以预测、观察和测量的。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 1: Exploring & designing
front: What is a control variable?
back: A control variable is any other factor that may affect the results of the investigation and must therefore be controlled for as far as possible.
frontZh: 什么是控制变量？
backZh: 一个控制变量是可能影响调查结果的任何其他因素，因此必须尽可能加以控制。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 1: Exploring & designing
front: What steps need to be taken for an experiment to be valid.
back: For an experiment to be valid, any variable that may affect the results needs to be controlled for.
frontZh: 需要采取哪些步骤才能使实验有效。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 1: Exploring & designing
front: Why is it important to calibrate measuring equipment prior to taking any readings?
back: It is important to calibrate measuring equipment prior to taking any readings to make sure the values given by the measuring device are accurate.
frontZh: 为什么在读取任何读数之前校准测量设备很重要？
backZh: 重要的是校准在获取任何读数之前检查测量设备，以确保测量设备给出的值符合准确的。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 2: Collecting & processing
front: What are precise measurements?
back: Precise measurements have very little spread about the mean value, i.e. they are close to each other.
frontZh: 什么是精确的测量？
backZh: 精确测量值与平均值的偏差非常小，即它们接近于平均值彼此。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 2: Collecting & processing
front: What are accurate measurements?
back: Accurate measurements are close to the true value.
frontZh: 什么是准确的测量？
backZh: 准确的测量值接近真实价值。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 2: Collecting & processing
front: True or False? Zero errors affect the precision of measurements.
back: False. Zero errors are a type of systematic error, so they affect the accuracy of measurements, not precision.
frontZh: 是真是假？零误差影响测量的精度。
backZh: 错误的。零误差是系统误差的一种，因此它们会影响准确性测量结果，而不是精度。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 2: Collecting & processing
front: Define reliability.
back: Reliability is a measure of the ability of an experimental procedure to produce the expected results when using the same method and equipment.
frontZh: 定义可靠性。
backZh: 可靠性是使用相同方法和设备时实验程序产生预期结果的能力的度量。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 2: Collecting & processing
front: Define validity.
back: Validity is a measure of the suitability of an experimental procedure to measure what it is intended to measure.
frontZh: 定义有效性。
backZh: 有效性是衡量实验程序是否适合测量其预期测量内容的指标。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 3: Concluding & evaluating
front: How do random errors arise?
back: Random errors arise from unpredictable fluctuations in an instrument’s readings due to uncontrollable factors, affecting the precision of measurements.
frontZh: 怎么办随机误差出现？
backZh: 随机误差是由于不可控制的因素导致仪器读数出现不可预测的波动而产生的，影响了精确测量值。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 3: Concluding & evaluating
front: How do systematic errors arise?
back: Systematic errors arise from faulty instruments or flaws in the experimental method, affecting the accuracy of measurements.
frontZh: 怎么办系统错误出现？
backZh: 系统误差是由于仪器故障或实验方法缺陷而产生的，影响了结果准确性测量值。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 3: Concluding & evaluating
front: What is a zero error?
back: A zero error is a type of systematic error that occurs when an instrument gives a reading when the true reading is zero.
frontZh: 什么是零误差？
backZh: 零误差是一种系统误差，当仪器在真实读数为零时给出读数时，就会发生这种误差。

subtopicFull: Inquiry 3: Concluding & evaluating
front: How can random errors be reduced?
back:
Random errors can be reduced by
• repeating measurements several times and calculating an average
• using a device with smaller measuring intervals
frontZh: 如何减少随机误差？
backZh:
随机误差可以通过以下方式减少
• 多次重复测量并计算平均值
• 使用测量间隔较小的设备

subtopicFull: Inquiry 3: Concluding & evaluating
front: How can systematic errors be reduced?
back:
Systematic errors can be reduced by
• re-calibrating instruments or using different instruments
• making corrections or adjustments to the technique
frontZh: 如何减少系统误差？
backZh:
系统误差可以通过以下方式减少
• 重新校准仪器或使用不同的仪器
• 对技术进行修正或调整

图中所示，与水平面成 θ 角的力 F 的垂直分量方程为 Fᵧ = F sin θ
其中：
• F = 合力，单位为牛顿 (N)
• θ = 合力与水平面的角度，以度 (°) 为单位

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: State the equation for the horizontal component of the force F at an angle θ to the horizontal shown in the diagram.
back:
The equation for the horizontal component of the force F at an angle θ to the horizontal shown in the diagram is F<sub>x</sub> = F cos θ
Where:
• F = resultant force, measured in newton's (N)
• θ = angle of resultant force to horizontal, measured in degrees (°)
frontZh: 写出图中所示与水平面成 θ 角的力 F 的水平分量的方程。
backZh:
图中所示，与水平面成角度 θ 的力 F 的水平分量的方程为 F<sub>x</sub> = F cos θ
其中：
• F = 合力，以牛顿 (N) 为单位测量
• θ = 合力与水平面的角度，以度 (°) 为单位

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: A scale of 2 cm = 1 km is given in a vector scale diagram. State the actual distance represented by 5 cm in the scale diagram.
back: The actual distance represented by 5 cm in the scale diagram is 2.5 km. • (2 cm / 2) × 5 = (1 km / 2) × 5 • 5 cm = (5 / 2) km

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.

back: The actual distance represented by 7.5 cm in the scale diagram is 22.5 km. • (5 cm / 5) × 7.5 = (15 km / 5) × 7.5 • 7.5 cm = (45 / 2) km

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What is the SI base unit for the amount of a substance?
back: The SI base unit for the amount of a substance is the mole (mol).
frontZh: SI 基本单位是什么物理量某种物质的?
backZh: 物质的量的 SI 基本单位是痣（摩尔）。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What is dimensional analysis?
back: Dimensional analysis is a method used to check the homogeneity of physical equations by studying the units.
frontZh: 什么是维度分析？
backZh: 尺寸分析是一种通过研究单位来检查物理方程均匀性的方法。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Show that the equation  p = mv is a homogeneous equation.
back:
An equation is homogeneous if the SI base units are the same on both sides.
• p = mv
• (kg m s<sup>−1</sup>) = (kg) × (m s<sup>−1</sup>)
• (kg m s<sup>−1</sup>) = (kg m s<sup>−1</sup>)
frontZh: 证明方程 p = mv 是齐次方程。
backZh:
如果两边的 SI 基本单位相同，则方程是齐次的。
• p = mv
•（公斤米秒<sup>−1</sup>) = (公斤) × (米·秒<sup>−1</sup>）
•（公斤米秒<sup>−1</sup>) = (公斤·米·秒<sup>−1</sup>）

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Show that the equation E<sub>k</sub> = (p<sup>2</sup> / 2m) is a homogeneous equation.
back:
An equation is homogeneous if the SI base units are the same on both sides.
• E<sub>k</sub> = (p<sup>2</sup> / 2m)
• (kg m<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) = ((kg<sup>2</sup> m<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) / (kg))
• (kg m<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) = (kg m<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>)
frontZh: 证明方程 E<sub>k</sub> =（p<sup>2</sup> / 2m) 是一个齐次方程。
backZh:
如果两边的 SI 基本单位相同，则方程是齐次的。
• E<sub>k</sub> =（p<sup>2</sup> / 2m)
•（公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) = ((公斤<sup>2</sup> 米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) / (公斤))
•（公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) = (公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>）

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Show that the equation P = Fv is a homogeneous equation.
back:
An equation is homogeneous if the SI base units are the same on both sides.

frontZh: 证明方程 P = Fv 是齐次方程。
backZh:
如果两边的 SI 基本单位相同，则方程是齐次的。
• P = Fv
•（（公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−2</sup>) / (s)) = (kg m s<sup>−2</sup>) × (米 s<sup>−1</sup>）
•（公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−3</sup>) = (公斤米<sup>2</sup> s<sup>−3</sup>）

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Show that the equation T = 2π√((m / k)) is a homogeneous equation.
back:
An equation is homogeneous if the SI base units are the same on both sides.
• T = 2π√((m / k))
• (1 / (s)) = √(((kg) / (N m<sup>−1</sup>)))= √(((kg) / (kg m s<sup>−2</sup>)(m<sup>−1</sup>)))
• (1 / (s)) = √((1 / ( s<sup>−2</sup>))) = (1 / (s))

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: If a length is measured as 15.3 ± 0.2 cm, what is the absolute uncertainty in the measurement?
back: The absolute uncertainty in the measurement is ± 0.2 cm. • length = 15.3 ± 0.2 cm • measurement = 15.3 cm • absolute uncertainty = ± 0.2 cm
frontZh: 如果测量长度为 15.3 ± 0.2 厘米，那么是多少绝对不确定性在测量中?
backZh: 测量的绝对不确定度为±0.2厘米。 • 长度 = 15.3 ± 0.2 厘米 • 测量= 15.3 厘米 • 绝对不确定度 = ± 0.2 cm

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: If a current is measured as 5.5 ± 0.1 A, what is the fractional uncertainty in the measurement?
back: The fractional uncertainty in the measurement is ± 0.02. • current = 5.5 ± 0.1 A • measurement = 5.5 A • fractional uncertainty = (0.1 / 5.5) = ± 0.02
frontZh: 如果测得电流为 5.5 ± 0.1 A，则该电流是多少分数不确定性在测量中?
backZh: 测量的分数不确定度为±0.02。 • 电流 = 5.5 ± 0.1 A • 测量= 5.5 A • 分数不确定性 = (0.1 / 5.5) = ± 0.02

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: If a mass is measured as 250 ± 5 g, what is the percentage uncertainty in the measurement?
back: The percentage uncertainty in the measurement is ± 2%. • mass = 250 ± 5 g • measurement = 250 g • percentage uncertainty = (5 / 250)×100% = ± 2%
frontZh: 如果测得的质量为 250 ± 5 g，则其质量是多少百分比不确定性在测量中?
backZh: 测量的不确定度百分比为±2%。 • 质量= 250 ± 5 g • 测量= 250 克 • 百分比不确定度 = (5/250)×100% = ± 2%

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: How do you find the uncertainty in a reading?
back: The uncertainty in a reading is ± half the smallest division.
frontZh: 如何发现不确定性阅读？
backZh: 的不确定性阅读是±最小除法的一半。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: How do you find the uncertainty in a measurement?
back: The uncertainty in a measurement is at least ±1 smallest division.
frontZh: 如何发现不确定性测量？
backZh: 的不确定性测量至少为 ±1 最小分度。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: How do you find the uncertainty of a set of readings?
back: The uncertainty in a set of readings is half the range, or ± ½ (largest - smallest value).
frontZh: 如何找到一个问题的不确定性一组读数？
backZh: 的不确定性一组读数是范围的一半，或 ± ½（最大值 - 最小值）。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: True or False? When adding or subtracting data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of their percentage uncertainties.
back: False. When adding or subtracting data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of their absolute uncertainties.
frontZh: 是真是假？添加或减去数据时，组合不确定性是其百分比不确定性之和。
backZh: 错误的。当添加或减去数据时，组合的不确定性是它们的总和绝对不确定性。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: True or False? When multiplying or dividing data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of their fractional or percentage uncertainties.
back: True. When multiplying or dividing data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of their fractional or percentage uncertainties.
frontZh: 是真是假？当将数据相乘或相除时，组合不确定性是其分数或百分比不确定性的总和。
backZh: 真的。当对数据进行乘法或除法时，组合的不确定性是它们的总和分数或者百分比不确定性。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What is the rule for propagating the uncertainty of a quantity which is raised to a power?
back: When a quantity is raised to a power, multiply the fractional or percentage uncertainty by the power.
frontZh: 传播某个量的幂的不确定性的规则是什么？
backZh: 当某个量求幂时，将分数或百分比不确定性乘以该幂。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: If two measured lengths, 12.3 ± 0.2 cm and 7.8 ± 0.1 cm, are added together, what is their combined uncertainty?
back: Combined uncertainty = 0.2 cm + 0.1 cm = 0.3 cm When adding data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of their absolute uncertainties.
frontZh: 如果两个测量长度 12.3 ± 0.2 厘米和 7.8 ± 0.1 厘米加在一起，它们的综合不确定度是多少？
backZh: 综合不确定度 = 0.2 cm + 0.1 cm =0.3厘米添加数据时，组合的不确定性是它们的总和绝对不确定性。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Find the percentage uncertainty in speed when dividing a distance measurement 4.5 m ± 2% by a time measurement 1.2 s ± 1%.
back: Percentage uncertainty in speed = 2% + 1% = 3%. When dividing data, the combined uncertainty is the sum of the percentage uncertainties.
frontZh: 将距离测量值 4.5 m ± 2% 除以时间测量值 1.2 s ± 1%，求出速度的不确定度百分比。
backZh: 速度不确定度百分比 = 2% + 1% =3%。 划分数据时，组合的不确定性是以下各项的总和：百分比不确定性。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: A cylinder of volume V = πr<sup>2</sup>h has a radius of 5.0 ± 0.2 cm and a height of 10.0 ± 0.5 cm. Calculate the percentage uncertainty in the volume.
back: Percentage uncertainty in volume = 13%. • ((∆V / V)) = 2((∆r / r)) + ((∆h / h)) • ((∆V / V)) = 2((0.2 / 5.0)) + ((0.5 / 10.0)) = 0.13 • percentage uncertainty = 0.13 × 100% = 13%
frontZh: 体积为 V = πr 的圆柱体<sup>2</sup>h 的半径为 5.0 ± 0.2 cm，高度为 10.0 ± 0.5 cm。计算体积的不确定性百分比。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What do error bars show on a graph?
back: Error bars are lines drawn above and below (or from side to side of) a point on a graph to show the absolute uncertainty of that measurement.
frontZh: 误差线在图表上显示什么？
backZh: 误差线是在图表上某个点的上方和下方（或从一侧到另一侧）绘制的线，用于显示该测量的绝对不确定度。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: True or False? Error bars on a graph must all be the same size.
back: False. Error bars on a graph can have different sizes as they represent different uncertainties for each data point.
frontZh: 是真是假？图表上的误差线必须全部具有相同的大小。
backZh: 错误的。图表上的误差线可以具有不同的大小，因为它们代表每个数据点的不同不确定性。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: Define a line of best fit.
back: A line of best fit is a line that passes as close to all plotted points as possible on a graph.
frontZh: 定义一个最佳拟合线。
backZh: 最佳拟合线是一条尽可能接近图表上所有绘制点的线。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What is the difference between a 'best' and 'worst' line of best fit?
back:
A 'best' line of best fit is a line that passes as close to all plotted points as possible on a graph.
A 'worst' line of best fit is either the steepest or shallowest possible line that fits within all the error bars on a graph.
frontZh: 最佳拟合线的“最佳”和“最差”有什么区别？
backZh:
最佳拟合的“最佳”线是尽可能靠近图表上所有绘制点的线。
最佳拟合的“最差”线是适合图表上所有误差线的最陡或最浅的线。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: State the equation for percentage uncertainty in gradient.
back:
The equation for percentage uncertainty in gradient is:
• percentage uncertainty = (best gradient - worst gradient / best gradient)×100%
frontZh: 陈述梯度不确定性百分比的方程。
backZh:
梯度不确定度百分比的方程为：
• 百分比不确定性=（最佳梯度-最差梯度/最佳梯度）×100%

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: What is percentage difference?
back: Percentage difference is an indication of how close the experimental value is to the accepted value.
frontZh: 什么是百分比差异？
backZh: 百分比差异表明实验值与可接受值的接近程度。

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: State the equation for percentage difference.
back:
The equation for percentage difference is:
• percentage difference = (experimental value - accepted value / accepted value)×100%
frontZh: 说出百分比差异的方程式。
backZh:
百分比差异的公式为：
• 百分比差异=（实验值-可接受值/可接受值）×100%

subtopicFull: Tool 3 Mathematics: Orders, significant figures, graphing and uncertainty tools.
front: True or False? The smaller the percentage difference, the greater the accuracy of the results of the experiment.
back: True. The smaller the percentage difference, the greater the accuracy of the results of the experiment.
frontZh: 是真是假？百分比差异越小，实验结果的准确性就越高。
backZh: 真的。百分比差异越小，实验结果的准确性就越高。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define distance.
back: Distance is the total length travelled by an object.

backZh: 距离是物体行进的总长度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define displacement.
back: Displacement is the distance from a reference point in a specified direction.
frontZh: 定义位移。
backZh: 排量是在指定方向上距参考点的距离。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What is the difference between distance and displacement?
back: The difference between distance and displacement is: • distance is a scalar quantity, with magnitude but no direction • displacement is a vector quantity, with magnitude and direction.
frontZh: 距离和位移有什么区别？
backZh: 距离和位移之间的差异是：•距离是一个标量物理量，与震级但没有方向•位移是向量物理量，与震级和方向。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Distance describes how far an object is from where it started and in what direction.
back: False. Displacement describes how far an object is from where it started and in what direction.
frontZh: 是真是假？距离描述了物体距其起点有多远以及朝哪个方向。
backZh: 错误的。 排量描述了一个物体距离它的起点有多远以及朝哪个方向。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define speed.
back: Speed is the distance an object travels per unit time. Useful formula — Speed: \[ v = \frac{\Delta s}{\Delta t} \]
frontZh: 定义速度。
backZh: 速度是物体单位时间内移动的距离。 有用的公式——速度：\[ v = \frac{\Delta s}{\Delta t} \]

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Speed is a scalar quantity with magnitude but no direction.
back: True. Speed is a scalar quantity with magnitude but no direction.
frontZh: 是真是假？速度是一个有大小但没有方向的标量。
backZh: 真的。速度是一个标量有大小但没有方向的物理量。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define velocity.
back:
Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.

Useful formula — Velocity:
\[
\vec v = \frac{\Delta \vec s}{\Delta t}
\]
frontZh: 定义速度。
backZh:
速度是位移的变化率。

有用的公式——速度：\[
\vec v = \frac{\Delta \vec s}{\Delta t}
\]

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Velocity is speed in a given direction.
back: True. Velocity is speed in a given direction.
frontZh: 是真是假？速度是给定方向上的速度。
backZh: 真的。速度是给定方向上的速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define instantaneous speed.
back: Instantaneous speed is the speed of an object at any given point in time.
frontZh: 定义瞬时速度。
backZh: 瞬时速度是物体在任意给定条件下的速度时间点。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: How is instantaneous velocity found from a displacement-time graph?
back: To find instantaneous velocity from a displacement-time graph: • draw a tangent to the curve at the required time • calculate the gradient of the tangent
frontZh: 如何从位移-时间图中找到瞬时速度？
backZh: 从位移-时间图中求瞬时速度：•在所需时间绘制曲线的切线•计算切线的梯度

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the equation for average velocity.
back: Average velocity: v̄ = Δx / Δt For uniform acceleration: v̄ = (u + v) / 2 v̄ average velocity (m s−1); Δx change in position (m); Δt time (s); u initial velocity; v final velocity.
frontZh: 说出平均速度的方程。
backZh: 平均速度：v̄ = Δx / Δt对于匀加速：v̄ = (u + v) / 2v̄ 平均速度 (m s−1）； Δx位置变化（m）； Δt时间(s)； u 初速度； v 最终速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define acceleration.
back: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity. Useful formula — Acceleration: \[ \vec a = \frac{\Delta \vec v}{\Delta t} \]
frontZh: 定义加速度。
backZh: 加速度是速度的变化率。 有用的公式——加速度：\[ \vec a = \frac{\Delta \vec v}{\Delta t} \]

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Is acceleration a scalar or vector quantity?
back: Acceleration is a vector quantity with both magnitude and direction.
frontZh: 加速度是标量还是矢量？
backZh: 加速度是向量量，其大小为，方向为。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the equation for average acceleration.
back: Average acceleration: a = Δv / Δt a average acceleration (m s−2); Δv change in velocity (m s−1); Δt time interval (s).
frontZh: 说出平均加速度的方程。
backZh: 平均加速度：a = Δv / Δt平均加速度（m·s-2）； Δv 速度变化（m s-1）； Δt 时间间隔（秒）。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the equation for change in velocity.
back: Change in velocity: Δv = v − u Δv change in velocity; v final velocity; u initial velocity. All velocities are measured in m s−1.
frontZh: 陈述速度变化的方程。
backZh: 速度变化：Δv = v − u速度变化Δv； v 最终速度； u 初速度。所有速度均以 m s-1为单位测量。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define instantaneous acceleration.
back: Instantaneous acceleration is the acceleration of an object at a given point in time. \[ a = \frac{dv}{dt} \]
frontZh: 定义瞬时加速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? If an object changes direction at a constant speed, the object is accelerating.
back: True. If an object changes direction at a constant speed, the object is accelerating.
frontZh: 是真是假？如果物体以恒定速度改变方向，则该物体正在加速。
backZh: 正确。如果物体以恒定速度改变方向，则物体正在加速。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What are the kinematic equations used for?
back: The kinematic equations are used for describing the motion of objects undergoing uniform acceleration.
frontZh: 运动学方程有什么用？
backZh: 运动学方程用于描述经历匀加速的物体的运动。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the kinematic equation for calculating final velocity, v, from acceleration, a, and time, t.
back: Final velocity: v = u + at v final velocity; u initial velocity; a acceleration; t time.
frontZh: 说明根据加速度a和时间t计算最终速度v的运动学方程。
backZh: 最终速度：v = u + atv 最终速度； u 初速度；加速度；时间。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the kinematic equation for calculating displacement, s, from acceleration, a, and time, t.
back: Displacement: s = ut + ½at2 s displacement; u initial velocity; t time; a acceleration.
frontZh: 说明根据加速度a和时间t计算位移s的运动学方程。
backZh: 位移：s = ut + ½at2s 位移； u 初速度；时间；一个加速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the kinematic equation for calculating displacement, s, from initial velocity, u, and final velocity, v.
back: Displacement: s = ((v + u) / 2)t s displacement; v final velocity; u initial velocity; t time.
frontZh: 陈述用于根据初始速度u和最终速度v计算位移s的运动学方程。
backZh: 位移：s = ((v + u) / 2)ts 位移； v 最终速度； u 初速度；时间。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: State the kinematic equation for calculating final velocity, v, from acceleration, a, and displacement, s.
back: Final velocity from displacement: v2 = u2 + 2as v final velocity; u initial velocity; a acceleration; s displacement.
frontZh: 陈述用于根据加速度a和位移s计算最终速度v的运动学方程。
backZh: 位移的最终速度：v2= u2+ 2asv 最终速度； u 初速度；加速度； s 位移。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What does it mean if an object starts from rest?
back: If an object starts from rest, it means that its initial velocity is zero.
frontZh: 如果一个物体从静止开始意味着什么？
backZh: 如果一个物体从静止开始，则意味着它的初速度为零。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What are the three types of motion graph?
back: The three types of motion graphs are: • displacement-time • velocity-time • acceleration-time
frontZh: 三种运动图类型是什么？
backZh: 三种类型的运动图是：•位移-时间•速度-时间•加速时间

frontZh: 是真是假？位移-时间图的y截距等于初始位移。

frontZh: 速度-时间图的梯度代表什么？

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.

back: False. The y intercept of a velocity-time graph is equal to the initial velocity.
frontZh: 是真是假？速度-时间图的y截距等于初始位移。
backZh: 错误。速度-时间图的y截距等于初始速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? The area under a velocity-time graph is equal to the displacement.
back: True. The area under a velocity-time graph is equal to the displacement.
frontZh: 是真是假？速度-时间图下方的面积等于位移。
backZh: 正确。速度-时间图下方的面积等于位移。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What does the gradient of an acceleration-time graph represent?

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? The y intercept of an acceleration-time graph is equal to the initial acceleration.
back: True. The y intercept of an acceleration-time graph is equal to the initial acceleration.
frontZh: 是真是假？加速时间图的y截距等于初始加速度。
backZh: 正确。加速时间图的y截距等于初始加速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? The area under an acceleration-time graph is equal to the acceleration.
back: False. The area under an acceleration-time graph is equal to the change in velocity.
frontZh: 是真是假？加速度-时间图下方的面积等于加速度。
backZh: 错误。加速时间图下方的面积等于速度变化。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What is a projectile?
back: A projectile is a particle that moves freely under gravity in a two-dimensional plane.
frontZh: 什么是弹丸？
backZh: 射弹是一个粒子，在重力作用下在二维平面中自由移动。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define the time of flight of a projectile.
back: The time of flight of a projectile is the total time it is in the air.
frontZh: 定义射弹的飞行时间。
backZh: 弹丸的飞行时间是它在空中的总时间。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define the range of a projectile.
back: The range of a projectile is the horizontal distance it travels.
frontZh: 定义射弹的射程。
backZh: 射弹的射程是它行进的水平距离。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define the maximum height attained by a projectile.
back: The maximum height attained by a projectile is the height at which it is momentarily at rest, where the vertical velocity component equals zero.
frontZh: 定义弹丸达到的最大高度。
backZh: 抛射体达到的最大高度是其在暂时静止时的高度，其中垂直速度分量等于零。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? The vertical velocity component of an object in projectile motion at maximum height is zero.
back: True. The vertical velocity component of the velocity of an object in projectile motion is zero at maximum height.
frontZh: 是真是假？抛射运动的物体在最大高度处的垂直速度分量为零。
backZh: 真的。物体抛射运动速度的垂直速度分量为零在最大高度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What is the equation for the vertical component of the velocity of an object in projectile motion.
back: Vertical component: v_y = u sinθ v_y vertical velocity component; u resultant velocity; θ angle to the horizontal.
frontZh: 的方程式是什么垂直分量物体抛射运动的速度。
backZh: 垂直分量：v_y = u sinθv_y垂直速度分量； u 合成速度；与水平面的夹角 θ。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What is the equation for the horizontal component of the velocity of an object in projectile motion?
back: Horizontal component: v_x = u cosθ v_x horizontal velocity component; u resultant velocity; θ angle to the horizontal.
frontZh: 的方程式是什么水平分量物体抛射运动的速度？
backZh: 水平分量：v_x = u cosθv_x 水平速度分量； u 合成速度；与水平面的夹角 θ。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: How do you calculate the horizontal distance, D, travelled by an object in projectile motion?
back: Horizontal distance: D = ut u initial horizontal velocity (m s−1); t time of flight (s).
frontZh: 如何计算物体在抛射运动中移动的水平距离D？
backZh: 水平距离：D = utu 初始水平速度（m s-1）； t 飞行时间。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: What is the vertical component of acceleration of an object in projectile motion?
back: The vertical component of acceleration is the acceleration due to gravity. • moving upwards: g = −9.8 m s−2 • moving downwards: g = +9.8 m s−2
frontZh: 抛射运动物体的加速度的垂直分量是多少？
backZh: 加速度的垂直分量是重力加速度。•向上移动： g = −9.8 m s−2•向下移动： g = +9.8 m s−2

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Which set of equations are used to evaluate the horizontal and vertical components of projectile motion?
back:
Resolve the initial velocity into horizontal and vertical components, then treat the two directions separately.

For launch speed \(u\) at angle \(\theta\):

\[
u_x = u\cos\theta
\]

\[
u_y = u\sin\theta
\]

Horizontal motion usually has constant velocity:

\[
a_x = 0, \qquad x = u_x t
\]

Vertical motion has constant acceleration due to gravity:

\[
a_y = -g
\]

Use the SUVAT equations separately in the vertical direction, for example:

\[
y = u_y t + \frac{1}{2}a_y t^2
\]

\[
v_y = u_y + a_y t
\]
frontZh: 使用哪组方程来计算弹丸运动的水平分量和垂直分量？
backZh:
将初始速度分解为水平和垂直分量，然后分别处理两个方向。

对于发射速度\(u\)成角度\(\theta\):\[
u_x = u\cos\theta
\]

\[
u_y = u\sin\theta
\]水平运动通常具有恒定速度：\[
a_x = 0, \qquad x = u_x t
\]由于重力的作用，垂直运动具有恒定的加速度：\[
a_y = -g
\]在垂直方向上分别使用SUVAT方程，例如：\[
y = u_y t + \frac{1}{2}a_y t^2
\]

\[
v_y = u_y + a_y t
\]

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define fluid resistance.
back: Fluid resistance is a frictional force that opposes the motion of an object moving through a fluid.
frontZh: 定义流体阻力。
backZh: 流体阻力是抵抗物体在流体中运动的摩擦力。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Define the term fluid.
back: A fluid is a gas or a liquid. The particles in a fluid are free to move around.
frontZh: 定义术语流体。
backZh: 流体是气体或液体。流体中的颗粒可以自由移动。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Fluid resistance is the same as viscous drag.
back: True. Fluid resistance is another name for viscous drag.
frontZh: 是真是假？流体阻力与粘性阻力相同。
backZh: 正确。流体阻力是粘性阻力的另一个名称。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Frictional forces always act to oppose the motion of the object.
back: True. Frictional forces always act to oppose the motion of the object.
frontZh: 是真是假？摩擦力总是阻碍物体的运动。
backZh: 真的。摩擦力总是起作用反对物体的运动。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Frictional forces never transfer energy away from the moving object.
back: False. Frictional forces always transfer energy away from the moving object.
frontZh: 是真是假？摩擦力永远不会将能量从移动的物体上转移走。
backZh: 错误的。摩擦力总是将能量从移动的物体转移走。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Fluid resistance increases as the speed of the object increases.
back: True. Fluid resistance increases as the speed of the object increases.
frontZh: 是真是假？流体阻力随着物体速度的增加而增加。
backZh: 真的。流体阻力增加随着物体速度的增加。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Name the factors affected by fluid resistance in projectile motion.
back: The factors affected by fluid resistance in projectile motion are: • time of flight • horizontal velocity • horizontal acceleration • range • shape of trajectory
frontZh: 指出抛射运动中受流体阻力影响的因素。
backZh: 抛射运动中受流体阻力影响的因素有：•飞行时间•水平速度•水平加速度•系列•轨迹形状

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Air resistance decreases the horizontal component of the velocity of a projectile so both its range and maximum height will decrease compared to an identical situation with no air resistance.
back: True. Air resistance decreases the horizontal component of the velocity of a projectile, so both its range and maximum height will decrease compared to an identical situation with no air resistance (like a vacuum).
frontZh: 是真是假？空气阻力会降低射弹速度的水平分量，因此与没有空气阻力的相同情况相比，其射程和最大高度都会减小。
backZh: 真的。空气阻力降低速度的水平分量的射弹，所以它的范围和最大高度与没有空气阻力（如真空）的相同情况相比，会减少。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Air resistance increases the time of flight of a projectile.
back: False. Air resistance decreases the time of flight of a projectile.
frontZh: 是真是假？空气阻力会增加射弹的飞行时间。
backZh: 错误的。空气阻力减少射弹的飞行时间。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? Air resistance changes the shape of the trajectory of a projectile.
back: True. Air resistance changes the shape of the trajectory of a projectile; it is no longer a parabola, and its path is steeper on the way down than it is on the way up.
frontZh: 是真是假？空气阻力改变射弹轨迹的形状。
backZh: 正确。空气阻力改变弹丸轨迹的形状；它不再是抛物线，并且其下降路径比上升路径更陡峭。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? For an object in free fall in a vacuum, the only force acting on it is weight.
back: True. For an object in free fall in a vacuum, the only force acting on it is weight. In a vacuum, there are no particles, so there are no drag forces to oppose the motion.
frontZh: 是真是假？对于在真空中自由落体的物体，作用在其上的唯一力是重量。
backZh: 正确。对于真空中自由落体的物体，作用在其上的唯一力是重量。 在真空中，没有粒子，因此没有阻力来阻止运动。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? For an object in free fall, viscous drag increases as the object accelerates.
back: True. For an object in free fall, viscous drag increases as the object accelerates.
frontZh: 是真是假？对于自由落体的物体，粘性阻力随着物体加速而增加。
backZh: 正确。对于自由落体的物体，粘性阻力随着物体加速而增加。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Explain how an object in free fall reaches terminal speed.
back:
Object reaches terminal speed:
weight > drag → resultant force downward → accelerates → drag increases with speed → drag = weight → resultant force = 0 → constant terminal speed.
frontZh: 解释自由落体中的物体如何达到极限速度。
backZh:
物体达到极限速度：
重量 > 阻力 → 向下的合力 → 加速 → 阻力随速度增加 → 阻力 = 重量 → 合力 = 0 → 恒定的终端速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: Explain how a skydiver in free fall at terminal speed achieves a new terminal speed after opening their parachute.
back:
After the parachute opens:
drag increases → drag > weight → resultant force upward → decelerates → drag decreases → drag = weight → resultant force = 0 → new slower terminal speed.
frontZh: 解释以终端速度自由落体的跳伞员打开降落伞后如何达到新的终端速度。
backZh:
降落伞打开后：
阻力增加→阻力>重量→合力向上→减速→阻力减小→阻力=重量→合力=0→新的较慢的终端速度。

subtopicFull: A.1 Kinematics: Vectors, motion graphs, projectile motion.
front: True or False? When a skydiver deploys a parachute, their direction of motion changes, and they accelerate upward.
back: False. When a skydiver deploys a parachute, the direction of the resultant force changes, and they decelerate while still falling downward. Their direction of motion does not change.
frontZh: 是真是假？当跳伞运动员打开降落伞时，他们的运动方向会改变，并且会加速向上。
backZh: 错误。当跳伞运动员打开降落伞时，合力的方向发生变化，它们在减速的同时仍然向下坠落。它们的运动方向而不是改变。

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: True or False? When drawing free-body force diagrams, objects can be represented as point particles placed at the object's centre of mass.
back: True. When drawing free-body force diagrams, objects are represented as point particles placed at the object's centre of mass.
frontZh: 是真是假？绘制自由体力图时，对象可以表示为放置在对象质心处的点粒子。
backZh: 真的。绘制自由体力图时，物体是表示为放置在物体质心的点粒子。

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: True or False? Free-body force diagrams show forces acting on multiple objects or systems.
back: False. Free-body force diagrams show multiple forces acting on one object or one system.
frontZh: 是真是假？自由体力图显示作用在多个物体或系统上的力。
backZh: 错误。自由体力图显示多个力作用于一个物体或一个系统。

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: State two quantities that a force arrow represents.
back: The two quantities that a force arrow represents are: • the magnitude of the force • the direction of the force
frontZh: 说出力箭头代表的两个量。
backZh: 力箭头代表的两个量是：•力的大小•方向的力

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: Define the term resultant force.
back: A resultant force is the vector sum of all the forces exerted on an object, which describes the combined action of all the forces.
frontZh: 定义术语合力。
backZh: 合力是施加在物体上的所有力的矢量和，它描述了所有力的联合作用。

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: True or False? When forces are balanced, they produce a non-zero resultant force.
back: False. When forces are balanced, they produce a resultant force of zero.
frontZh: 是真是假？当力平衡时，它们会产生非零的合力。
backZh: 错误。当力平衡时，它们会产生零的合力。

subtopicFull: A.2 Forces and Momentum: Newton’s laws, impulse, collisions, circular motion.
front: When two forces in different planes act on an object, how can the resultant force be found?
back:
When two forces act on an object in different planes, the resultant force can be found by resolving vectors.
This can be done by using: Pythagoras' theorem; trigonometry; vector diagrams (triangle or quadrilateral method)
frontZh: 当两个不同平面的力作用在一个物体上时，如何求合力？
backZh:
当两个力作用在不同平面上的物体上时，可以通过解析矢量得到合力。
这可以通过使用：毕达哥拉斯定理来完成；三角学；矢量图（三角形或四边形法）
