subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the principle of the conservation of energy.
back: The principle of the conservation of energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed, it can only be transferred from one form to another.
frontZh: 说出能量守恒定律。
backZh: 能量守恒定律指出，能量不能被创造或毁灭，它只能从一种形式转移到另一种形式。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define the term system as it is used in physics.
back: The term system in physics is defined as an object or group of objects.
frontZh: 定义物理学中使用的术语系统。
backZh: 物理学中的术语系统被定义为一个对象或一组对象。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What is the purpose of defining a system in physics?
back: The purpose of defining the system in physics is to narrow the parameters to focus only on what is relevant to the situation observed.
frontZh: 在物理学中定义系统的目的是什么？
backZh: 在物理学中定义系统的目的是缩小参数范围，仅关注与观察到的情况相关的内容。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State three types of energy.
back: Examples of different types of energy are: kinetic; gravitational potential; elastic potential; chemical; nuclear; internal; thermal
frontZh: 说明三种类型的能量。
backZh: 不同类型能量的例子有： 动能；重力势；弹性潜力；化学；核;内部的;热的

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the three energy types that are considered mechanical energy types.
back: The three energy types that are considered as mechanical energy types are: • kinetic • gravitational potential • elastic potential
frontZh: 说明三种被视为机械能类型的能量类型。
backZh: 被视为机械能类型的三种能量类型是：•动力学•引力势•弹性势

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? The total amount of energy in a closed system can change over time.
back: False. The total amount of energy in a closed system remains constant; it cannot change over time according to the principle of conservation of energy.
frontZh: 是真是假？封闭系统中的总能量会随着时间的推移而变化。
backZh: 错误。封闭系统中能量的总量保持恒定；根据能量守恒原理，它不会随时间变化。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define the term dissipated energy.
back: The term dissipated energy means wasted energy transferred to the surroundings that cannot easily be used for another purpose. Energy is usually dissipated as heat, light and sound.
frontZh: 定义术语耗散能量。
backZh: 术语耗散能量表示浪费的能量转移到周围环境中，不能轻易用于其他目的。能量通常以热、光和声音的形式耗散。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the three types of energy involved in the vertical oscillation of a mass on a spring.
back: The three types of energy involved in the vertical oscillation of a mass on a spring are: • gravitational potential energy • kinetic energy • elastic potential energy
frontZh: 说出弹簧上质量块垂直振动所涉及的三种类型的能量。
backZh: 弹簧上的质量块垂直振荡涉及的三种能量是：•重力势能•动能•弹性势能

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: For a horizontal mass-spring system, the gravitational potential energy does not need to be considered. Why is this?
back: For a horizontal mass-spring system, the gravitational potential energy does not need to be considered because the objects are moving horizontally, so the gravitational potential energy does not change, because \(\Delta h = 0\). Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 对于水平质量弹簧系统，不需要考虑重力势能。这是为什么呢？
backZh: 对于水平质量弹簧系统，不需要考虑重力势能，因为物体是水平移动的，所以重力势能不会改变，因为\(\Delta h = 0\)。 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What are Sankey diagrams used for?
back: Sankey diagrams are used to represent energy transfers.
frontZh: 桑基图有什么用？
backZh: 桑基图用于表示能量转移。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What does the straight horizontal (green) arrow represent on a Sankey diagram?
back: The straight horizontal (green) arrow on a Sankey diagram represents the useful energy output.
frontZh: 桑基图上的水平直线（绿色）箭头代表什么？
backZh: 桑基图上的直水平（绿色）箭头表示有用能量输出。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What do the curved downwards pointing (blue) arrows represent on a Sankey diagram?
back: The curved downward pointing (blue) arrows on a Sankey diagram represent wasted energy.
frontZh: 桑基图上向下弯曲的（蓝色）箭头代表什么？
backZh: 桑基图上的向下弯曲（蓝色）箭头表示浪费的能量。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: How can the total energy input be determined from a Sankey diagram?
back: The total energy input can be determined from a Sankey diagram by the flat edge of the arrows or by the useful plus the wasted energy values.
frontZh: 如何从桑基图确定总能量输入？
backZh: 总能量输入可以从 Sankey 图通过箭头的平边或通过有用的加上浪费的能量值来确定。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the efficiency of this energy transfer.
back: The efficiency of this energy transfer is 24% or 0.24. • efficiency = useful energy out / total energy in • efficiency = 120/500 × 100% = 24% Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 说明这种能量转移的效率。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? Work is done when a force is applied to an object, regardless of whether the object moves or not.
back: False. Work is done when a force is applied to an object and results in the object's movement over a distance in the direction of the force. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 是真是假？当对物体施加力时，无论物体是否移动，都会做功。
backZh: 错误。当对物体施加力并导致物体沿力的方向移动一段距离时，就完成了功。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? Work done is equivalent to energy transferred.
back: True. The work done by a resultant force on a system is equivalent to the energy transferred. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 是真是假？所做的功相当于转移的能量。
backZh: 正确。合力对系统所做的功相当于传递的能量。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the units of work done.
back: The units of work done are newton metres (Nm) or joules (J). 1 Nm = 1 J Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 说明已完成的工作单位。
backZh: 所做功的单位为牛顿米(Nm) 或焦耳(J)。 1 牛米 = 1 焦耳 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define mechanical work done.
back: Mechanical work done is the transfer of energy that occurs when an external force causes an object to move over a distance. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 定义完成的机械功。
backZh: 完成的机械功是当外部力导致物体移动距离时发生的能量转移。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for mechanical work done.
back: The equation for mechanical work done is W = Fs Where: • W = work done, measured in newton metres (Nm) or joules (J) • F = force applied, measured in newtons (N) • s = displacement, measure in metres (m) Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 说出完成的机械功的方程。
backZh: 完成机械功的方程为W = Fs其中：•W= 完成的功，以牛顿米 (Nm) 或焦耳 (J) 为单位测量•F= 施加的力，以牛顿 (N) 为单位测量•s= 位移，单位为米 (m) 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? The work done equation, W = Fs, can only be used if the force applied is constant.
back: True. The work done equation, W = Fs, can only be used if the force applied is constant. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 是真是假？做功方程W = Fs只能在施加的力恒定时使用。
backZh: 正确。做功方程W = Fs只能在施加的力恒定时使用。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for mechanical work done when the force is applied at an angle to the object's displacement.
back: The equation for mechanical work done is W = Fs cosθ Where: W = work done, measured in newton metres (Nm) or joules (J); F = force applied, measured in newtons (N); s = displacement, measure in metres (m); θ = angle between force applied and displacement, measured in degrees (°) Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 陈述当力以与物体位移成一定角度施加时所做的机械功的方程。
backZh: 完成机械功的方程为W = Fs cosθ其中：W= 完成的功，以牛顿米 (Nm) 或焦耳 (J) 为单位；F= 施加的力，单位为牛顿 (N)；s= 位移，单位为米（m）；θ= 施加的力和位移之间的角度，以度 (°) 为单位测量 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define kinetic energy.
back: Kinetic energy is the energy an object has due to its translational motion. Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 定义动能。
backZh: 动能是物体由于其平移运动而具有的能量。 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What are the units for kinetic energy?
back: The units for kinetic energy are joules (J). The units for all types of energy are joules.
frontZh: 动能的单位是什么？
backZh: 动能的单位是焦耳 (J)。所有类型能量的单位均为焦耳。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for kinetic energy.
back: The equation for kinetic energy is Ek = ½mv2 Where: • Ek = kinetic energy, measured in joules (J) • m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg) • v = velocity, measured in metres per second (m s−1) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 说出动能方程。
backZh: 动能方程为Ek= ½mv2其中：•Ek= 动能，单位为焦耳 (J)•m= 质量，以千克 (kg) 为单位测量•v= 速度，以米每秒为单位测量 (m s−1) 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for kinetic energy when velocity is the subject.
back: The equation for kinetic energy when velocity is the subject is v = √(2Ek/m) Where: v = velocity, measured in metres per second (m s−1); Ek = kinetic energy, measured in joules (J); m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 陈述以速度为主题时的动能方程。
backZh: 以速度为主体时的动能方程为v = √(2Ek/m)其中：v= 速度，以米每秒为单位（m s-1）；Ek= 动能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位；m= 质量，单位为千克（kg） 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for kinetic energy in terms of momentum.
back: The equation for kinetic energy in terms of momentum is Ek = p2/(2m) Where: Ek = kinetic energy, measured in joules (J); p = momentum, measured in kilogram metres per second (kg m s−1); m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 用动量表述动能方程。
backZh: 以动量表示的动能方程为Ek= p2/(2m)其中：Ek= 动能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位；p= 动量，以千克米每秒为单位测量 (kg m s-1)；m= 质量，单位为千克（kg） 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: How can the equation for kinetic energy in terms of momentum be derived from the kinetic energy equation?
back: The equation for kinetic energy in terms of momentum be derived from the kinetic energy equation as follows: • Ek = ½mv2 = mv2/2 = m2v2/(2m) = (mv)2/(2m) = p2/(2m) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 如何从动能方程推导出以动量表示的动能方程？
backZh: 以动量表示的动能方程由动能方程导出如下：•Ek= ½mv2= mv2/2 = m2v2/(2m) = (mv)2/(2m) = p2/(2m)有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define gravitational potential energy.
back: Gravitational potential energy is the energy that an object has due to its position in a gravitational field. Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 定义重力势能。
backZh: 引力势能是物体由于其在引力场中的位置而具有的能量。 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for gravitational potential energy in a uniform gravitational field.
back: The equation for gravitational potential energy in a uniform gravitational field is ΔEp = mgΔh Where: ΔEp = change in gravitational potential energy, measured in joules (J); m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg); g = gravitational field strength, measured in newtons per kilogram (N kg−1); Δh = change in height, measured in metres (m) Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 陈述均匀引力场中的引力势能方程。
backZh: 均匀引力场中的引力势能方程为ΔEp= mgΔh其中：ΔEp= 重力势能的变化，以焦耳 (J) 为单位；m= 质量，单位为千克（kg）；g= 引力场强度，单位为牛顿每千克 (N kg−1)；Δh= 高度变化，以米 (m) 为单位 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? The gravitational potential energy of an object is directly proportional to its change in height in the gravitational field.
back: True. The gravitational potential energy of an object is directly proportional to its change in height in the gravitational field. Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 是真是假？物体的重力势能与其在引力场中的高度变化成正比。
backZh: 正确。物体的引力势能为与其在引力场中的高度变化成正比。 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for gravitational potential energy in a uniform gravitational field when mass is the subject.
back: The equation for gravitational potential energy in a uniform gravitational field is m = Ep/(gΔh) Where: m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg); ΔEp = change in gravitational potential energy, measured in joules (J); g = gravitational field strength, measured in newtons per kilogram (N kg−1); Δh = change in height, measured in metres (m) Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 陈述以质量为主体时均匀引力场中的引力势能方程。
backZh: 均匀引力场中的引力势能方程为m = Ep/(gΔh)其中：m= 质量，单位为千克（kg）；ΔEp= 重力势能的变化，以焦耳 (J) 为单位测量；g= 引力场强度，单位为牛顿每千克 (N kg−1)；Δh= 高度变化，以米 (m) 为单位 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? The gravitational field strength on Earth is 8.9 N kg−1.
back: False. The gravitational field strength on Earth is 9.8 N kg−1. Useful formula — Gravitational field strength: \[ g = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{GM}{r^2} \]
frontZh: 是真是假？地球上的引力场强度为8.9 N·kg-1。
backZh: 错误。地球上的引力场强度为9.8 N kg-1。 有用的公式——引力场强度：\[ g = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{GM}{r^2} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? As an object with mass is raised in a uniform gravitational field, its gravitational potential energy decreases.
back: False. As an object with mass is raised in a uniform gravitational field, its gravitational potential energy increases. Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy: \[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]
frontZh: 是真是假？当一个有质量的物体在均匀引力场中上升时，它的引力势能会减小。
backZh: 错误。当一个有质量的物体在均匀引力场中上升时，它的引力势能增加。 有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[ \Delta E_p = mg\Delta h \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define elastic potential energy.
back: Elastic potential energy is defined as the energy stored within a material when it is stretched or compressed.
frontZh: 定义弹性势能。
backZh: 弹性势能定义为材料在拉伸或压缩时存储在材料内的能量。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for the elastic potential energy of an object that obeys Hooke's law.
back: The equation for the elastic potential energy of an object that obeys Hooke's law is EH = ½kΔx2 Where: EH = elastic potential energy, measured in joules (J); k = spring constant, measured in newtons per metre (N m−1); Δx = extension of material, measured in metres (m) Useful formula — Hooke’s law: \[ F = kx \]
frontZh: 说出遵守胡克定律的物体的弹性势能方程。
backZh: 遵守胡克定律的物体的弹性势能方程为EH= ½kΔx2其中：EH= 弹性势能，单位为焦耳 (J)；k= 弹簧常数，以牛顿每米为单位测量 (N m−1)；Δx= 材料的延伸，以米 (m) 为单位测量 有用的公式——胡克定律：\[ F = kx \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation linking the elastic potential energy of an object and the restoring force.
back: The equation linking the elastic potential energy of an object and the restoring force is EH = ½FΔx Where: EH = elastic potential energy, measured in joules (J); F = restoring force, measured in newtons (N); Δx = extension of material, measured in metres (m)
frontZh: 陈述连接物体弹性势能和恢复力的方程。
backZh: 连接物体弹性势能和恢复力的方程为EH= ½FΔx其中：EH= 弹性势能，单位为焦耳 (J)；F= 恢复力，单位为牛顿 (N)；Δx= 材料的延伸，以米 (m) 为单位

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the expression showing a perfect transfer of elastic potential energy into kinetic energy.
back: The expression showing a perfect transfer of elastic potential energy into kinetic energy is ½kΔx2 = ½mv2 Where: k = restoring force, measured in newtons (N); m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg); v = speed of wire, measured in metres per second (m s−1); Δx = extension of material, measured in metres (m)
frontZh: 陈述弹性势能完美转换为动能的表达式。
backZh: 弹性势能完美转换为动能的表达式为½kΔx2= ½mv2其中：k= 恢复力，单位为牛顿 (N)；m= 质量，单位为千克（kg）；v= 线速，以米每秒为单位测量 (m s−1)；Δx= 材料的延伸，以米 (m) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Why is it dangerous when a wire under stress suddenly breaks?
back: It is dangerous when a wire under stress suddenly breaks because the elastic potential energy stored in the strained wire is converted into kinetic energy. The greater the extension of a wire, the greater the speed it will have when it breaks.
frontZh: 为什么当受压的电线突然断裂时会很危险？
backZh: 当受力的金属丝突然断裂时是危险的，因为受拉的金属丝中存储的弹性势能转换为动能。电线的延伸量越大，其断裂时的速度越大。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the mathematical expression for mechanical energy.
back: The mathematical expression for mechanical energy is mechanical energy = Ek + ΔEp + EH Where: Ek = kinetic energy, measured in joules (J); ΔEp = change in gravitational potential energy, measured in joules (J); EH = elastic potential energy, measured in joules (J)
frontZh: 说出机械能的数学表达式。
backZh: 机械能的数学表达式为机械能 = Ek+ ΔEp+ EH其中：Ek= 动能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位；ΔEp= 重力势能的变化，以焦耳 (J) 为单位测量；EH= 弹性势能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? The change in the total mechanical energy of a system is the work done on the system by any non-conservative force.
back: True. The change in the total mechanical energy of a system is the work done on the system by any non-conservative force. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 是真是假？系统总机械能的变化是任何非保守力对系统所做的功。
backZh: 正确。系统总机械能的变化是任何非保守力对系统所做的功。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define a non-conservative force.
back: A non-conservative force is one that dissipates energy away from the system.
frontZh: 定义一个非保守力。
backZh: 非保守力是从系统中耗散能量的力。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Give one example of a system with mechanical energy.
back: Examples of systems with mechanical energy are: • mass-spring system • simple pendulum • any system in simple harmonic motion
frontZh: 举一个具有机械能的系统的例子。
backZh: 具有机械能的系统的例子有：•质量弹簧系统•简摆•任何简谐振动系统

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? In the absence of non-conservative forces, mechanical energy is always conserved.
back: True. In the absence of non-conservative forces, mechanical energy is always conserved.
frontZh: 是真是假？在没有非保守力的情况下，机械能总是守恒的。
backZh: 正确。在没有非保守力的情况下，机械能始终守恒。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define power.
back:
Power is the rate at which energy is transferred.

Useful formula — Power:
\[
P = \frac{\Delta E}{\Delta t}
\]
frontZh: 定义功率。
backZh:
功率是能量传输的速率。

有用的公式——功率：\[
P = \frac{\Delta E}{\Delta t}
\]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? Power is equal to work done.
back: False. Work done is equal to energy transferred. Therefore, power is equal to the rate of work done, or work done per unit time. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 是真是假？权力等于完成的工作。
backZh: 错误。所做的功等于转移的能量。因此，功率等于做功的速率，或单位时间做的功。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for power.
back: The equation for power is: P = ΔW/Δt Where: • P = power, measured in watts (W) • ΔW = change in work done, measured in joules (J) • Δt = change in time, measured in seconds (s)
frontZh: 陈述功率的方程。
backZh: 功率方程为：P = ΔW/Δt其中：•P= 功率，单位为瓦 (W)•ΔW= 所做功的变化，以焦耳 (J) 为单位•Δt= 时间变化，以秒 (s) 为单位

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the equation for power in terms of force and velocity.
back: The equation for power is: P = Fv Where: • P = power, measured in watts (W) • F = constant force applied, measured in newtons (N) • v = constant velocity, measured in metres per second (m s−1)
frontZh: 用力和速度陈述功率方程。
backZh: 功率方程为：P = Fv其中：•P= 功率，单位为瓦 (W)•F= 施加的恒定力，以牛顿 (N) 为单位测量•v= 恒定速度，以米每秒为单位测量 (m s−1)

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define 1 watt (W).
back: The watt is the unit of power. 1 watt = 1 joule per second.
frontZh: 定义1 瓦(W)。
backZh: 瓦特是功率的单位。 1 瓦特 = 1 焦耳每秒。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define efficiency.
back:
Efficiency is defined as the ratio of the useful power (or energy transfer) output from a system to its total power (or energy transfer) input.

Useful formula — Efficiency:
\[
\eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}}
\]
frontZh: 定义效率。
backZh:
效率定义为系统输出的有用功率（或能量传输）与其总功率（或能量传输）输入的比率。

有用的公式——效率：\[
\eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}}
\]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the symbol for efficiency.
back: The symbol for efficiency is the Greek letter eta, η. Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 说出效率的符号。
backZh: 效率的符号是希腊字母eta，η。 有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: True or False? An energy transfer with a higher efficiency has a lower amount of wasted energy.
back: True. An energy transfer with a higher efficiency has a lower amount of wasted energy. Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 是真是假？效率较高的能量传输会减少能源浪费。
backZh: 正确。效率较高的能量传输会减少能源浪费。 有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What are the units of efficiency?
back: Efficiency has no units because it is a ratio. Efficiency is expressed as a decimal between zero and one, or as a percentage. Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 效率的单位是什么？
backZh: 效率为，没有单位，因为它是比率。效率以零到一之间的小数或百分比表示。 有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the efficiency equation in terms of power.
back: The efficiency equation in terms of power is η = useful power out / total power in Where: • η = efficiency (no units as it is a ratio) Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 陈述以功率为单位的效率方程。
backZh: 以功率表示的效率方程为η = 有用功率输出 /中的总功率 其中：•η= 效率（没有单位，因为它是比率） 有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the efficiency equation in terms of work done.
back: The efficiency equation in terms of work done is η = useful work out / total work in Where: • η = efficiency (no units as it is a ratio) Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 根据完成的工作陈述效率方程。
backZh: 完成工作的效率方程为η = 有用工作 /中的总工作 其中：•η= 效率（没有单位，因为它是比率） 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: State the efficiency equation in terms of energy transferred.
back: The efficiency equation in terms of energy is η = useful energy out / total energy in Where: • η = efficiency (no units as it is a ratio) Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh: 陈述以传递能量为单位的效率方程。
backZh: 以能量表示的效率方程为η = 有用能量输出 /中的总能量 其中：•η= 效率（没有单位，因为它是比率） 有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front:
Motor A has an efficiency of 0.8 and Motor B has an efficiency of 0.7. The total power input to each motor is 1000 J.
What is the amount of wasted energy for each motor?
back: Motor A has 200 J of wasted energy, and Motor B has 300 J of wasted energy. • wasted energy = (1 − η) × total energy in • Motor A: 0.2 × 1000 = 200 J • Motor B: 0.3 × 1000 = 300 J Useful formula — Efficiency: \[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]
frontZh:
电机 A 的效率为 0.8，电机 B 的效率为 0.7。每个电机的总输入功率为 1000 J。
每台电机浪费的能量是多少？
backZh: 电机 A有200 J浪费的能量，电机 B有300 J浪费的能量。•浪费的能量 = (1 − η) ×中的总能量•电机 A：0.2 × 1000 = 200 J•电机 B：0.3 × 1000 = 300 J有用的公式——效率：\[ \eta = \frac{\text{useful output}}{\text{total input}} \]

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: What is a fuel?
back: A fuel is anything that can be burned to produce heat, which can be used for an engine to work.
frontZh: 什么是燃油？
backZh: 燃料是可以由燃烧产生热量的任何物质，可用于发动机工作。

subtopicFull: A.3 Work, Energy, and Power: Conservation of energy, efficiency, kinetic/potential energy.
front: Define energy density.
back: Energy density is the amount of energy that a fuel can provide per unit volume of fuel.
frontZh: 定义能量密度。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: Define a moment.
back: A moment is the product of a force and the perpendicular distance from a pivot. It describes the turning effect of a force around a particular point, usually when the rotation is incomplete.
frontZh: 定义力矩。
backZh: 力矩是力和距枢轴的垂直距离的乘积。 它描述了力围绕特定点的转动效果，通常当旋转为不完整时。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: Define a couple.
back: A couple is a pair of forces which are equal in size and act parallel to each other but in opposite directions and along different lines of action on either side of the axis of rotation.
frontZh: 定义对。
backZh: 力偶是一对力，其大小为等于，作用在上，彼此平行于，但在上的方向与方向相反，并沿着在旋转轴的两侧产生不同的作用线。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: True or False? A couple produces a net linear force.
back: False. A couple does not produce a net linear force; it produces a turning effect called torque.
frontZh: 是真是假？力偶产生净线性力。
backZh: 错误。力偶不会产生净线性力；它产生称为扭矩的旋转效应。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What is the SI base unit for torque?
back: The SI base unit for torque is newton metres (N m).
frontZh: 扭矩的 SI 基本单位是什么？
backZh: 扭矩的 SI 基本单位是牛顿米 (N·m)。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What effect does the angle, θ, between the force and the axis of rotation have on the resultant torque?
back: The effect of angle on the resultant torque is: • when the angle is 90° (perpendicular to the axis of rotation), the resultant torque is at a maximum • as the angle decreases, torque decreases • when the angle is 0° (parallel to the axis of rotation), the resultant torque is zero
frontZh: 力与旋转轴之间的角度 θ 对合成扭矩有何影响？
backZh: 角度对合成扭矩的影响为： • 当角度为 90° 时（垂直到旋转轴），合成扭矩为最大限度• 随着角度减小，扭矩减少• 当角度为0°时（平行线到旋转轴），合成扭矩为零

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What is rotational equilibrium?
back: Rotational equilibrium is when there is no resultant torque acting on a system.
frontZh: 什么是旋转平衡？
backZh: 旋转平衡是指当没有合力作用在系统上时。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: Define the principle of moments.
back: The principle of moments states that a body is in rotational equilibrium if the sum of the clockwise moments (torques) is equal to the sum of the anticlockwise moments (torques).
frontZh: 定义矩原理。
backZh: 力矩原理指出，如果顺时针力矩之和（扭矩）等于逆时针力矩之和（扭矩），则物体处于旋转平衡。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: True or False? In rotational equilibrium, the sum of the torques must be zero.
back: True. In rotational equilibrium, the sum of the torques must be zero.
frontZh: 是真是假？在旋转平衡中，扭矩之和必须为零。
backZh: 正确。在旋转平衡中，扭矩之和必须为零。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What is the condition for a beam to be in rotational equilibrium?
back: If a beam is in rotational equilibrium: total clockwise torque = total anticlockwise torque.
frontZh: 梁达到旋转平衡的条件是什么？
backZh: 如果梁处于旋转平衡：总顺时针扭矩 = 总逆时针扭矩。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: Define unbalanced torque.
back: Unbalanced torque is when the net resultant torque is not zero, causing angular acceleration.
frontZh: 定义不平衡扭矩。
backZh: 不平衡扭矩是指净合扭矩不为零，导致角加速度。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: State whether a plank supported at two points is in rotational equilibrium at the point just before it begins to tip.
back: A plank supported at two points is in rotational equilibrium at the point just before it begins to tip is in rotational equilibrium.
frontZh: 说明由两点支撑的木板在开始倾斜之前的那一点是否处于旋转平衡。
backZh: 由两点支撑的木板在开始倾斜之前的点处于旋转平衡是处于旋转平衡的。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: How can you make calculations of resultant torque as easy as possible?
back: To make calculations of resultant torque as easy as possible you should take torque above the point where most of the forces are unknown or zero.
frontZh: 如何尽可能轻松地计算合成扭矩？
backZh: 为了使合成扭矩的计算尽可能简单，您应该将扭矩置于大多数力未知或为零的点之上。

front: Define angular displacement.
back: Angular displacement is the angle through which a rigid body has rotated from a fixed reference position.

backZh: 角位移是刚体从固定的参考位置旋转经过的角度。

backZh: 角位移的单位\(\delta \theta\)为弧度（或度）。

front: Define the term moment of inertia.
back:
Moment of inertia is the resistance of a body to changes in rotational motion. It depends on how the mass is distributed relative to the chosen axis of rotation.
\[ I = \sum mr^2 \]
Here, \(m\) is each mass element and \(r\) is its perpendicular distance from the axis of rotation.

frontZh: 是真是假？旋转动能取决于线速度。
backZh: 错误。旋转动能取决于角速度。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What does it mean when an object rolls without slipping?
back: Rolling without slipping is when an object rolls such that its point of contact with the surface has zero velocity relative to the surface.
frontZh: 当物体滚动而不滑动时，这意味着什么？
backZh: 滚动而不滑动是指物体滚动，使其与表面的接触点相对于表面的速度为零。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: True or False? The total kinetic energy of a rolling object includes both translational and rotational kinetic energy.
back: True. The total kinetic energy of a rolling object is the sum of its translational and rotational kinetic energy.
frontZh: 是真是假？滚动物体的总动能包括平动动能和旋转动能。
backZh: 正确。滚动物体的总动能是其平动动能和旋转动能之和。

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What is the equation for the total kinetic energy of a rolling object?
back: The equation for the total kinetic energy of a rolling object is Where: • m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg) • v = linear velocity, measured in metres per second (m s−1) • I = moment of inertia, measured in kilograms metres squared (kg m2) • ω = angular velocity, measured in radians per second (rad s−1) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 滚动物体的总动能方程是什么？
backZh: 滚动物体的总动能方程为其中：• m = 质量，以千克 (kg) 为单位测量 • v = 线速度，以米每秒为单位测量 (m s−1) • I = 惯性矩，以千克米平方为单位测量 (kg m2) • ω = 角速度，以弧度每秒为单位测量 (rad s−1) 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What other forms of energy is gravitational potential energy converted into as an object rolls down a slope?
back:
Gravitational potential energy is converted into translational and rotational kinetic energy as an object rolls down a slope.

Useful formula — Gravitational potential energy:
\[
\Delta E_p = mg\Delta h
\]
frontZh: 当物体滚下斜坡时，重力势能会转化为哪些其他形式的能量？
backZh:
当物体滚下斜坡时，重力势能转化为平动动能和旋转动能。

有用的公式 - 重力势能：\[
\Delta E_p = mg\Delta h
\]

subtopicFull: A.4 Rigid Body Mechanics: Rotational kinematics, torque, moment of inertia, angular momentum.
front: What is the moment of inertia for a solid sphere?
back:
For a solid sphere rotating about its centre:

\[
I = \frac{2}{5}mr^2
\]

where \(m\) is the mass and \(r\) is the radius of the sphere.
frontZh: 实心球体的转动惯量是多少？
backZh:
对于绕其中心旋转的实心球体：\[
I = \frac{2}{5}mr^2
\]其中\(m\)是质量，\(r\)是球体的半径。

subtopicFull: A.5 – Galilean And Special Relativity
front:
Student A and Student B are running a race. At time \(t = 0\), they are the same distance away from the finish line. At \(t = 5\text{s}\), someone at the finish line waves a flag.

As viewed by Student A, the position of the flag is \(65\text{m}\) away.

As viewed by Student B, the position of the flag is \(71\text{m}\) away.

What is the speed of Student A as viewed by Student B?
back:
Select Student B as the reference frame , and Student A as the moving object. Then, just assign the values to each variable accordingly:
\[x' = x - vt \Rightarrow v = \frac{x - x'}t = \frac{71 - 65}{5}\]

back: An inertial reference frame is defined as a reference frame that is non-accelerating.
frontZh: 定义术语惯性参考系。
backZh: 惯性参考系定义为非加速参考系。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? All inertial reference frames are moving at a constant velocity with respect to each other.
back: True. All inertial reference frames are moving at a constant velocity with respect to each other.
frontZh: 是真是假？所有惯性参考系都相对于彼此以恒定速度移动。
backZh: 正确。所有惯性参考系相对于彼此以恒定速度移动。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.

back: True. All locations within the Universe are moving relative to each other.
frontZh: 是真是假？宇宙中的所有位置都在相对移动。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front:
A person on one side of the road sees a car moving to the left.
In which direction does a person on the opposite side of the road see the car moving?
back: The person on the opposite side of the road will see the car moving to the right from their frame of reference.
frontZh:
路一侧的人看到一辆汽车向左行驶。
路对面的人看到汽车朝哪个方向行驶？
backZh: 道路对面的人会看到汽车从他们的参考系移动到右侧。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front:
A person on a train platform sees a person on a moving train as moving.
Who is moving from the frame of reference of the person on the train?
back: The person on the train sees themselves as stationary, so from their frame of reference, the person on the platform is moving relative to them.
frontZh:
站在火车站台上的人会看到行驶中的火车上的人在移动。
谁正在从火车上的人的参照系中移动？
backZh: 火车上的人认为自己是静止的，因此从他们的参考系来看，站台上的人相对于他们正在移动。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: Define the term Galilean relativity.
back: Galilean relativity is when Newton's laws of motion are the same in all inertial reference frames.
frontZh: 定义术语伽利略相对论。
backZh: 伽利略相对论是牛顿运动定律在所有惯性参考系中都相同的情况。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? In Galilean relativity, the same laws of physics apply, regardless of the frame of reference, as long as the reference frame is moving in a straight line at a constant velocity.
back: True. In Galilean relativity, the same laws of physics apply, regardless of the frame of reference, as long as the reference frame is moving in a straight line at a constant velocity.
frontZh: 是真是假？在伽利略相对论中，无论参考系如何，只要参考系以恒定速度沿直线移动，都适用相同的物理定律。
backZh: 正确。在伽利略相对论中，无论参考系如何，只要参考系以恒定速度沿直线移动，都适用相同的物理定律。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? In Galilean relativity, an object moving with a constant velocity in one reference frame will have a constant velocity in another reference frame.
back: True. In Galilean relativity, an object moving with a constant velocity in one reference frame will have a constant velocity in another reference frame, although the magnitude of its velocity will be different.
frontZh: 是真是假？在伽利略相对论中，在一个参考系中以匀速运动的物体在另一个参考系中也将具有匀速运动。
backZh: 正确。在伽利略相对论中，在一个参考系中以恒定速度移动的物体在另一参考系中将具有恒定速度，尽管其速度的幅度将与不同。

front: What are the Galilean transform equations used for?

front: State Einstein's two postulates of special relativity.
back:

• the laws of physics are the same in all inertial reference frames
• the speed of light in a vacuum is the same in all inertial reference frames

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: What is the condition for special relativity to apply?
back: Special relativity applies when objects are travelling close to the speed of light when time and space are also relative to the frame of reference.
frontZh: 狭义相对论的应用条件是什么？
backZh: 狭义相对论适用于物体以接近光速运动，且时间和空间也相对于参考系。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? Two different observers will always measure the speed of light to be the same value in their own reference frames.
back: True. Two different observers will always measure the speed of light to be the same value in their own reference frames.
frontZh: 是真是假？两个不同的观察者在他们自己的参考系中测量的光速总是相同的。
backZh: 正确。两个不同的观察者在他们自己的参考系中测量的光速总是相同的。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? Velocity addition only works at speeds much lower than the speed of light.
back: True. Velocity addition, or the Galilean transformation for the velocity of an object moving within the moving reference frame, only works at speeds much lower than the speed of light.
frontZh: 是真是假？速度加法仅在远低于光速的情况下起作用。
backZh: 真的。速度加法或在移动参考系内移动的物体速度的伽利略变换仅适用于速度低得多比光速。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: True or False? Galilean transformations predict that objects can travel faster than the speed of light.
back: True. Galilean transformations predict that objects can travel faster than the speed of light, but this cannot be the case, so for objects travelling at speeds close to the speed of light, Lorentz transformations must be used to correct this.
frontZh: 是真是假？伽利略变换预测物体的运动速度可以超过光速。
backZh: 正确。伽利略变换预测物体的运动速度可以超过光速，但事实并非如此，因此对于以接近光速的速度运动的物体，必须使用洛伦兹变换来纠正这一点。

subtopicFull: A.5 Galilean and Special Relativity: Reference frames, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, space-time diagrams.
front: What are the Lorentz transformations?
back: The Lorentz transformations are corrections to the Galilean transformations used when objects are travelling close to the speed of light.
frontZh: 什么是洛伦兹变换？
backZh: 洛伦兹变换是对物体以接近光速运动时使用的伽利略变换的修正。

front: True or False? The Lorentz factor for any moving object will always be less than 1.

Who measures the proper length?

subtopicFull: B.1 – Thermal Energy Transfers
front: Explain the equation: \(\lambda_\text{max}T = 2.9 \times 10^{-3}\text{m K}\)
back:
This equation describes the activity of a radioactive sample. Meaning of each symbol:
\(A\) is the activity, the number of decays per second. Its unit is the becquerel, \(\mathrm{Bq}\).
\(\lambda\) is the decay constant. It represents the probability per unit time that one unstable nucleus will decay.
\(N\) is the number of undecayed radioactive nuclei remaining at time \(t\).
\(N_0\) is the original number of radioactive nuclei when \(t=0\). The equation says that activity is proportional to the number of undecayed nuclei remaining. As time passes, \(N\) decreases exponentially, so the activity \(A\) also decreases exponentially.

该方程描述了放射性样品的活度。各符号含义：
\(A\)是活动，每秒的衰变次数。它的单位是贝克勒尔，\(\mathrm{Bq}\)。
\(\lambda\)是衰减常数。它表示单位时间内一个不稳定原子核衰变的概率。
\(N\)是在时间\(t\)时剩余的未衰变放射性核的物理量。
\(N_0\)是\(t=0\)时的原始放射性核数。 该方程表明，活性与剩余的未衰变原子核的物理量成正比。随着时间的推移，\(N\)呈指数下降，因此\(A\)的活性也呈指数下降。
