front: True or False? When an object is immersed in a fluid, forces act parallel to its surfaces to produce pressure.
back: False. When an object is immersed in a fluid, forces act perpendicular to its surfaces to produce pressure.
frontZh: 是真是假？当物体浸入流体中时，力平行于其表面作用以产生压力。
backZh: 错误的。当物体浸入液体中时，力作用垂直到其表面以产生压力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How do gas particles exert a force on the walls of a container?
back: Gas particles exert a force on the container by colliding with the walls. Over the area of a wall, this exerts a pressure.
frontZh: 气体粒子如何对容器壁施加力？
backZh: 气体粒子通过与壁碰撞而对容器施加力。这会在墙壁区域上施加压力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Which person exerts a higher pressure on the ground, a 70 kg person standing on one foot or a 100 kg person standing on both feet? Assume their feet are the same size.
back: The 70 kg person on one foot exerts a higher pressure. The 70 kg person exerts ~700 N per foot but the 100 kg person exerts ~500 N per foot, so the 70 kg person exerts a greater pressure.
frontZh: 70公斤重的人单脚站立和100公斤重的人双脚站立哪个对地面施加的压力更大？假设他们的脚大小相同。
backZh: 70公斤的人一只脚施加的压力更大。 70公斤的人每脚施加约700 N，但100公斤的人每脚施加约500 N，因此70公斤的人施加更大的压力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Recall the equation for pressure.
back: The equation for pressure is P = F/A Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • F = force, measured in newtons (N) • A = area measured in metres squared (m^2)
frontZh: 回想一下压力的方程。
backZh: 压力方程为P = F/A其中：•P= 压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•F= 力，单位为牛顿 (N)•A= 以米平方 (m^2) 为单位测量的面积

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? Gas particles travelling at a greater speed exert a greater force on container walls.
back: True. When gas particles collide with container walls at higher speeds, they exert a greater force and hence a greater pressure on the container.
frontZh: 是真是假？以更快的速度运动的气体颗粒对容器壁施加更大的力。
backZh: 正确。当气体粒子以较高的速度碰撞容器壁时，它们会施加更大的力，从而对容器施加更大的压力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? The frequency of collisions between particles and container walls is increased, but their speed remains constant. The pressure exerted by the gas is unchanged.
back: False. When gas particles collide with container walls more frequently, the average force is increased so the pressure increases.
frontZh: 是真是假？颗粒和容器壁之间的碰撞频率增加，但它们的速度保持恒定。气体施加的压力不变。
backZh: 错误。当气体粒子更频繁地碰撞容器壁时，平均力增加，因此压力增加。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Define one mole.
back: One mole is the amount of substance that contains as many elementary entities as the number of atoms in 12 g of carbon-12.
frontZh: 定义一摩尔。
backZh: 一摩尔是含有与 12 克碳 12 中的原子数一样多的基本实体的物质的量。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How many atoms are in one mole of argon (Ar)? Argon is a monatomic gas.
back: In one mole of argon there are \(6.02 \times 10^{23}\) atoms - this is the Avogadro constant.
frontZh: 一摩尔氩 (Ar) 中有多少个原子？氩是单原子气体。
backZh: 一摩尔氩气中有\(6.02 \times 10^{23}\)原子 - 这就是阿伏加德罗常数。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? There are 6.02 × 10^23 atoms in one mole of gaseous carbon dioxide.
back: False. In one mole of there are 6.02 × 10^23 elementary elements, but each elementary element has three atoms so there are 1.86 × 10^24 atoms in one mole of .
frontZh: 是真是假？一摩尔气态二氧化碳中有 6.02 × 10^23 个原子。
backZh: 错误。一摩尔 中有 6.02 × 10^23 个基本元素，但每个基本元素有 3 个原子，因此一摩尔 中有 1.86 × 10^24 个原子。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the equation for the number of moles in a substance when the number of particles is known.
back: The equation for the number of moles is n = N/N_A Where: • n = number of moles (mol) • N= number of particles (particles may be atoms or molecules, depending on the substance) • N_A= Avogadro constant, measured in particles per mole (mol^−1)
frontZh: 当粒子数已知时，写出物质的摩尔数方程。
backZh: 摩尔数的方程为n = N/N_A其中：•n= 摩尔数 (mol)•N=粒子数（粒子可以是原子或分子，取决于物质）•N_A=阿伏伽德罗常数，以每摩尔颗粒数测量 (mol^−1)

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the equation for molar mass when number of moles and mass is known.
back: The equation for molar mass is m_r = m/n Where: • m_r= molar mass, measured in grams per mole (g mol^−1) • m= mass of substance, measured in grams (g) • n= number of moles (mol)
frontZh: 当摩尔数和质量已知时，写出摩尔质量方程。
backZh: 摩尔质量的方程为m_r = m/n其中：•m_r=摩尔质量，以克每摩尔 (g mol^−1) 为单位测量•m=物质质量，以克 (g) 为单位•n=摩尔数 (mol)

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? There are fewer atoms in one mole of than there are in one mole of .
back: True. While both contain the same number of molecules, there are more atoms in a molecule of than in a molecule of .
frontZh: 是真是假？一摩尔中的原子数比一摩尔中的原子数少。
backZh: 正确。虽然两者都包含相同物理量的分子，但 的分子中的原子数比 的分子中的原子数要多。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How would the molar mass of \(\mathrm{H_2O}\) be determined if the relative atom masses of H and O are known?
back:
The molar mass in \(\mathrm{g\ mol^{-1}}\) is the sum of the relative atomic masses of the atoms in the molecule.

For \(\mathrm{H_2O}\):

\[
M = 2A_r(\mathrm{H}) + A_r(\mathrm{O})
\]
frontZh: 如果 H 和 O 的相对原子质量已知，如何确定\(\mathrm{H_2O}\)的摩尔质量？
backZh:
\(\mathrm{g\ mol^{-1}}\)中的摩尔质量是分子中原子的相对原子质量之和。

对于\(\mathrm{H_2O}\)：\[
M = 2A_r(\mathrm{H}) + A_r(\mathrm{O})
\]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What relation does an ideal gas obey?
back: An ideal gas obeys the relation PV ∝ T or PV/T = constant Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • V = volume, measured in cubic metres \(\mathrm{m^3}\) • T = temperature, measured in kelvin (K)
frontZh: 理想气体遵循什么关系？
backZh: 理想气体遵循关系式PV ∝ T或PV/T = 常数其中：•P =压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•V=体积，以立方米为单位\(\mathrm{m^3}\)•T=温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Define the meaning of an empirical law.
back: An empirical law is formed based on observed data from experiments, rather than being derived from theory.
frontZh: 定义经验定律的含义。
backZh: 经验律是根据实验观测数据形成的，而不是从理论推导出来的。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the equation for Boyle's law in terms of initial and final states.
back: Boyle's law in terms of initial and final states is P1V1 = P2V2 for a constant temperature. Where: • P_1 = initial pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • P_2 = final pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • V_1 = is initial volume, measured in cubic metres (m3) • V_2 = final volume, measured in cubic metres (m3)
frontZh: 用初始状态和最终状态写出波义耳定律的方程。
backZh: 对于恒定温度，波义耳定律的初始状态和最终状态为P1V1= P2V2。 其中：•P_1=初始压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•P_2=最终压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•V_1=是初始体积，以立方米 (m3) 为单位测量•V_2=最终体积，以立方米 (m3) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What is the relationship shown by the graph below?
back: The graph shows that pressure is inversely proportional to volume.
frontZh: 下图所示的关系是什么？
backZh: 该图显示压力与体积成反比。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the equation for Charles' law in terms of initial and final states.
back: Charles' law in terms of initial and final states is V1/T1 = V2/T2 for a constant pressure. Where: • T_1 = initial temperature, measured in kelvin (K) • T_2 = final temperature, measured in kelvin (K) • V_1 = initial volume, measured in cubic metres (m3) • V_2 = final volume, measured in cubic metres (m3)
frontZh: 根据初始状态和最终状态写出查尔斯定律的方程。
backZh: 对于恒定压力，初始状态和最终状态的查尔斯定律为V1/T1= V2/T2。 其中：•T_1=初始温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量•T_2=最终温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量•V_1=初始体积，单位为立方米 (m3)•V_2=最终体积，以立方米 (m3) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? The graph showing Charles' law is curved. The axes are volume and temperature (K).
back: False. The graph representing Charles' law is a straight line passing through the origin. The axes are volume and temperature (K).
frontZh: 是真是假？显示查尔斯定律的图表是弯曲的。轴是体积和温度 (K)。
backZh: 错误。代表查尔斯定律的图形是一条通过原点的直线。轴是体积和温度 (K)。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the equation for Gay-Lussac's law in terms of initial and final states.
back: Charles' law in terms of initial and final states is P1/T1 = P2/T2 for a constant volume. Where: • T_1 = initial temperature, measured in kelvin (K) • T_2 = final temperature, measured in kelvin (K) • P_1 = initial pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • P_2 = final pressure , measured in pascals (Pa)
frontZh: 用初始状态和最终状态写出盖-吕萨克定律的方程。
backZh: 对于恒定体积，初始状态和最终状态的查尔斯定律为P1/T1= P2/T2。 其中：•T_1=初始温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量•T_2=最终温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量•P_1=初始压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•P_2=最终压力，以帕斯卡 (Pa) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? The graph below shows a directly proportional relationship.
back: False. Gay-Lussac's law states that pressure is directly proportional to temperature in kelvin. This graph shows temperature in degrees Celsius and does not pass through the origin, so is not directly proportional.
frontZh: 是真是假？下图显示了正比例关系。
backZh: 错误。盖-吕萨克定律指出，压力与温度（开尔文）成正比。该图显示温度（以摄氏度为单位）并且不经过原点，因此不成正比。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the ideal gas equation when the number of moles is known.
back: The ideal gas equation for a known number of moles is PV = nRT Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • V = volume, measured in metres cubed (m^3) • n = number of moles measured in moles (mol) • R = gas constant, measured in joules per kelvin per mole (J K^−1 mol^−1) • T = temperature, measured in kelvin (K) Useful formula — Ideal gas equation: \[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]
frontZh: 当摩尔数已知时，写出理想气体方程。
backZh: 已知摩尔数的理想气体方程为PV = nRT其中：•P= 压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•V= 体积，以米立方 (m^3) 为单位测量•n= 摩尔数 (mol)•R= 气体常数，单位为焦耳每开尔文每摩尔 (J K^−1 mol^−1)•T= 温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量 有用的公式——理想气体方程：\[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Write the ideal gas equation when the number of particles is known.
back: The ideal gas equation for a known number of moles is PV = Nk_BT Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • V = volume, measured in metres-cubed (m^3) • N = number of particles • k_B = Boltzmann constant, measured in joules per kelvin (J K^−1) • T = temperature, measured in kelvin (K) Useful formula — Ideal gas equation: \[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]
frontZh: 当粒子数已知时，写出理想气体方程。
backZh: 已知摩尔数的理想气体方程为PV = Nk_BT其中：•P= 压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•V= 体积，以米立方 (m^3) 为单位测量•N= 颗粒数•k_B= 玻尔兹曼常数，以焦耳/开尔文为单位测量 (J K^−1)•T= 温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量 有用的公式——理想气体方程：\[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? The ideal gas law equation can be derived from the empirical gas laws for constant pressure and constant volume.
back: False. The ideal gas law equation can be derived from the empirical gas laws for constant pressure, constant volume and constant temperature. Useful formula — Ideal gas equation: \[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]
frontZh: 是真是假？理想气体定律方程可以从恒压和恒体积的经验气体定律导出。
backZh: 错误。理想气体定律方程可以从恒压、恒体积和恒温的经验气体定律导出。 有用的公式——理想气体方程：\[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How are the Boltzmann constant, gas constant and Avogadro constant related?
back: The Boltzmann constant, gas constant and Avogadro constant are related by: \[ k_{B} = \frac{R}{N_{A}} \] Equivalently: \[ R = N_{A}k_{B} \] Where: • \(k_{B}\) = Boltzmann constant, measured in joules per kelvin (J K−1) • \(R\) = molar gas constant, measured in joules per kelvin per mole (J K−1 mol−1) • \(N_{A}\) = Avogadro constant, measured in particles per mole (mol−1)
frontZh: 玻尔兹曼常数、气体常数和阿伏伽德罗常数有何关系？

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What is the ideal gas equation for a known number of particles when temperature is the subject?
back: The ideal gas equation for a known number of particles with temperature as the subject is T = PV/(Nk_B) Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • V = volume, measured in metres-cubed (m^3) • N = number of particles • k_B = Boltzmann constant, measured in joules per kelvin (J K^−1) • T = temperature, measured in kelvin (K) Useful formula — Ideal gas equation: \[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]
frontZh: 当温度是主题时，已知物理量的粒子的理想气体方程是什么？
backZh: 以温度为对象的已知粒子数的理想气体方程为T = PV/(Nk_B)其中：•P= 压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•V= 体积，以米立方 (m^3) 为单位测量•N= 颗粒数•k_B= 玻尔兹曼常数，以焦耳/开尔文为单位测量 (J K^−1)•T= 温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量有用的公式——理想气体方程：\[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How can the motion of particles in a gas be described?
back: Particles in a gas move: • randomly • at high speeds
frontZh: 如何描述气体中粒子的运动？
backZh: 气体中的粒子运动：•随机• 高速

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What two properties of gases does the kinetic theory of gases connect?
back: The kinetic theory of gases connects: • the microscopic properties of particles, e.g. mass and speed • the macroscopic properties of particles, e.g. pressure and volume
frontZh: 气体动力学理论将气体的哪两个性质联系起来？
backZh: 气体动力学理论连接：•颗粒的微观特性，例如质量和速度•粒子的宏观属性，例如压力和体积

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? Kinetic theory assumes that there is a small gravitational force between particles.
back: False. Kinetic theory assumes that no forces act between particles other than when they collide.
frontZh: 是真是假？动力学理论假设粒子之间存在很小的引力。
backZh: 错误。动力学理论假设除了碰撞之外，粒子之间没有任何力作用。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What are three assumptions made about forces in kinetic theory?
back: Any three of the following assumptions about forces made in kinetic theory: • The molecules obey Newton's laws of motion • There are no forces between the molecules except during collisions • External forces (e.g. gravity) are ignored • Each particle exerts a force on the wall of the container with which it collides.
frontZh: 动力学理论中关于力的三个假设是什么？
backZh: 动力学理论中关于力的以下任意三个假设：•分子遵守牛顿运动定律•除碰撞外，分子之间不存在力•忽略外力（例如重力）•每个粒子都会在与其碰撞的容器壁上施加力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What are three assumptions about the quantity and size of molecules in kinetic theory?
back: Any three of the following assumptions about molecules in kinetic theory: • A gas consists of identical molecules in a container • Molecules have negligible volume and are point particles • The number of molecules of gas in a container is very large so the average behaviour is considered
frontZh: 动力学理论中关于分子物理量和大小的三个假设是什么？
backZh: 动力学理论中关于分子的以下任意三个假设：•容器中由相同分子组成的气体•分子体积可忽略不计，为点粒子•容器中的气体分子数为非常大因此考虑平均行为

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What are three assumptions made about collisions in kinetic theory?
back: Three of the following assumptions about collisions in kinetic theory: • The molecules collide elastically • There are no forces between the molecules except during collisions • The time of a collision between molecules is negligible compared to the time between collisions • Each particle exerts a force on the wall of the container with which it collides.
frontZh: 动力学理论中关于碰撞的三个假设是什么？
backZh: 以下关于动力学理论中碰撞的三个假设：•分子弹性碰撞•除碰撞外，分子之间不存在力•分子之间的碰撞时间与碰撞之间的时间相比可以忽略不计•每个粒子都会在与其碰撞的容器壁上施加力。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? Real gases obey the ideal gas law.
back: False. Real gases do not obey the ideal gas law as the assumptions of kinetic theory are not always valid. Useful formula — Ideal gas equation: \[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]
frontZh: 是真是假？真实气体遵循理想气体定律。
backZh: 错误。真实气体并不遵守理想气体定律，因为动力学理论的假设并不总是有效。 有用的公式——理想气体方程：\[ PV = nRT = Nk_B T \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: What are the conditions for a gas to be considered an ideal gas?
back: The conditions for a gas to be ideal are: • the gas pressure is low • the gas density is low • the temperature is sufficiently higher than the boiling point of the substance
frontZh: 气体被认为是理想气体的条件是什么？
backZh: 理想气体的条件是：•气压低•气体密度低•温度充分高于物质的沸点

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Show that the change in momentum for a particle of mass, m, and initial speed, +v, is −2mv when it collides with a container wall.
back: The change in momentum is Δp = mΔv = m(v_f − v_i) After rebounding elastically, speed is −v in the negative direction. Therefore, change in momentum is Δp = mΔv = m((−v) − v) = −2mv
frontZh: 证明当质量为m且初始速度为+v的粒子与容器壁碰撞时，其动量变化为-2mv。
backZh: 动量变化为Δp = mΔv = m(v_f − v_i)弹性回弹后，负方向速度为-v。 因此，动量变化为Δp = mΔv = m((−v) − v) = −2mv

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Show that, for a particle with speed, v, crossing a container of width, L, the time between collisions with a particular wall is 2L/v.
back: To find the time between collisions: • The time between collisions is given by Δt = distance/speed • Between collisions, the particle travels the width of the container and back, 2L • The speed is v so Δt = 2L/v
frontZh: 证明，对于速度为v的粒子，穿过宽度为L的容器时，与特定壁碰撞之间​​的时间为2L/v。
backZh: 要查找碰撞之间的时间：•碰撞之间的时间由给出 Δt = 距离/速度•在碰撞之间，粒子沿容器的宽度移动并返回，2L•速度为v，因此Δt = 2L/v

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? If the time between collisions with a container wall for a particle is 2L/v and the change in momentum is −2mv then the force on the container wall is −mv2/L.
back: False. Force is rate of change of momentum, so −2mv/(2L/v) = −mv2/L is the force on the particle. The particle exerts an equal and opposite force of +mv2/L on the wall.
frontZh: 是真是假？如果粒子与容器壁碰撞的时间间隔为2L/v，动量变化为-2mv，则容器壁上的力为-mv2/L。
backZh: 错误的。力是动量的变化率，所以−2mv/(2L/v) = −mv2/升是力量在粒子上。粒子施加大小相等且方向相反的力+MV2/升 在墙上。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: State the kinetic theory of gases equation.
back: The kinetic theory of gases equation is P = ⅓ρv2 Where: • P = pressure, measured in pascals (Pa) • ρ = density of the gas, measured in kilograms per metre-cubed (kg ) • v = average speed of particles, measured in metres per second (m )
frontZh: 陈述气体动力学理论方程。
backZh: 气体动力学方程为P = ⅓ρv2其中：•P= 压力，单位为帕斯卡 (Pa)•ρ= 气体密度，单位为千克每立方米 (kg )•v= 粒子的平均速度，以米每秒 (m ) 为单位

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? When a single gas particle is assumed to travel only in the x direction, the square of its speed is only one third of the particle's actual speed in three dimensions.
back: True. The squared speed in the x direction, only accounts, on average, for one third of the square of the overall speed if the particle moves in all directions, so = ⅓v2
frontZh: 是真是假？当假设单个气体粒子仅沿 x 方向运动时，其速度的平方仅为粒子在三维空间中的实际速度的三分之一。
backZh: 正确。如果粒子向各个方向运动，则 x 方向速度的平方平均仅占总速度平方的三分之一，因此= ⅓v2

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: State the kinetic energy equation.
back: The kinetic energy equation is = ½mv2 Where: • = kinetic energy, measured in joules (J) • m = mass, measured in kilograms (kg) • v = speed, measured in metres per second (m) Useful formula — Kinetic energy: \[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]
frontZh: 说出动能方程。
backZh: 动能方程为= ½mv2其中：•= 动能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位•m= 质量，以千克 (kg) 为单位测量•v= 速度，以米每秒 (m) 为单位 有用的公式——动能：\[ E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \]

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: How are the following three equations combined to give E_k = 3/2 T? • P = Nmv2/(3V) • PV = NT • = ½mv2
back: To obtain the equation = 3/2 T: • Combine equations 1 and 3: P = Nmv2/(3V) = N × 2/(3V) • Rearrange this and equate to equation 2: 2/3 N = PV and PV = NT • 2/3 N = NT • Rearrange to give: = 3/2T
frontZh: 以下三个方程如何组合得出E_k = 3/2T？•P = Nmv2/(3V)•PV = NT•= ½mv2
backZh: 要获得方程= 3/2T：•合并方程 1 和 3：P = Nmv2/(3V) = N × 2/(3V)•重新排列并等于方程 2：2/3 N= PV和PV = NT•2/3 N= NT•重新整理得出：= 3/2T

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: In terms of the Boltzmann constant, what is the total internal energy of N particles of an ideal gas?
back: Total internal energy of an ideal gas is U = 3/2 NT Where: • U = total internal energy, measured in joules (J) • N = number of ideal gas particles • = Boltzmann constant, measured in joules per kelvin (J ) • T = temperature, measured in kelvin (K)
frontZh: 根据玻尔兹曼常数，理想气体的N粒子的总内能是多少？
backZh: 理想气体的总内能为U = 3/2 NT其中：•U= 总内能，以焦耳 (J) 为单位•N= 理想气体粒子数•= 玻尔兹曼常数，以焦耳每开尔文 (J ) 为单位测量•T= 温度，以开尔文 (K) 为单位测量

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: True or False? Total internal energy and total kinetic energy are not equal for a real gas.
back: True. In an ideal gas, total internal energy is total kinetic energy. In a real gas, however, internal energy is the sum of all kinetic and potential energies which arise from intermolecular interactions.
frontZh: 是真是假？对于实际气体来说，总内能和总动能是，而不是。
backZh: 正确。在理想气体中，总内能就是总动能。然而，在真正的气体中，内能是分子间相互作用产生的所有动能和势能的总和。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front: Why is it not possible to state that internal energy is proportional to temperature for  gas?
back: This relationship only applies to monatomic gases. is diatomic so also has rotational kinetic energy.
frontZh: 为什么不能说气体的内能与温度成正比？
backZh: 这种关系仅适用于单原子气体。 是双原子的，所以也有旋转动能。

subtopicFull: B.3 Gas Laws: Moles, ideal gases, Boltzmann equation.
front:
A low pressure sample of monatomic helium gas has an initial temperature of 450 K and a final temperature of 1800 K.
By what factor has its internal energy increased?
back:
For a monatomic ideal gas:

\[
U = \frac{3}{2}Nk_{B}T
\]

So, internal energy is proportional to temperature. Temperature has increased by a factor of 4, so the internal energy has also increased by a factor of 4.
frontZh:
单原子氦气的低压样品的初始温度为 450 K，最终温度为 1800 K。
其内能增加的因素有哪些？
backZh:
对于单原子理想气体：\[
U = \frac{3}{2}Nk_{B}T
\]因此，内能与温度成正比。温度增加了 4 倍，因此内能也增加了 4 倍。

subtopicFull: B.4 – Thermodynamics
front: A heat engine operates with a hot reservoir at 90°C and a cold reservoir at 25°C. During a cycle, it absorbs 940J of energy from the hot reservoir and returns 560J to the cold reservoir. Calculate the change in entropy during one complete cycle.
back:
We must extrapolate the given formula for change in entropy:
\[\Delta{S} = \frac{\Delta{Q}}{T} = \frac{Q_\text{in}}{T_\text{h}} - \frac{Q_\text{out}}{T_\text{c}}\]
\[\Delta{S} = \frac{+940}{90 + 273} - \frac{560}{25 + 273}\]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the relationship between kinetic energy and internal energy for an ideal gas?
back: For an ideal gas, internal energy is the total kinetic energy of all the particles.
frontZh: 理想气体的动能和内能之间有什么关系？
backZh: 对于理想气体，内能是所有粒子的总动能。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the equation for the first law of thermodynamics.
back:
The first law of thermodynamics can be written as:

\[
Q = \Delta U + W
\]

where \(Q\) is the thermal energy supplied to the system, \(\Delta U\) is the change in internal energy, and \(W\) is the work done by the system.

This means energy supplied by heating either increases the internal energy of the system or is used to do work.

If \(W_{\mathrm{on}}\) means work done on the system, then:

\[
\Delta U = Q + W_{\mathrm{on}}
\]
frontZh: 说出热力学第一定律的方程。
backZh:
热力学第一定律可以写成：\[
Q = \Delta U + W
\]其中\(Q\)是提供给系统的热能，\(\Delta U\)是内能的变化，\(W\)是系统所做的功。

这意味着加热提供的能量要么增加系统的内能，要么用于做功。

如果\(W_{\mathrm{on}}\)表示在系统上完成的工作，则：\[
\Delta U = Q + W_{\mathrm{on}}
\]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the sign of \(W\) when a gas is compressed by an external force?
back: When a gas is compressed by an external force, \(\Delta V\) is negative. Using the formula below, \(W\) is therefore positive. \[ W = -P_{ext}\Delta V \]
frontZh: 气体受外力压缩时\(W\)的符号是什么？
backZh: 当气体受到外力压缩时，\(\Delta V\)为负值。因此，使用下面的公式，\(W\)是正。\[ W = -P_{ext}\Delta V \]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the sign of W when work is done by a gas?
back: When work is done by a gas, W is positive. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 工作完成时W的符号是什么经过气体？
backZh: 当工作完成时经过气体，W 是积极的。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the sign of ΔU when a gas is heated and work is done on a gas?
back: When a gas is heated and work is done to it, its internal energy increases so ΔU is positive. Useful formula — Work done: \[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]
frontZh: 气体受热做功时ΔU的符号是什么在气体？
backZh: 当气体被加热并对其做功时，其内能增加，因此 ΔU 为正。 有用的公式——完成的工作：\[ W = Fs\cos\theta \]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the sign of ΔU when a gas transfers heat to its surroundings and expands?
back: Using the first law of thermodynamics: \[ \Delta U = Q - W \] When a gas transfers heat to its surroundings, \(Q\) is negative. When it expands, it does work on the surroundings, so \(W\) is positive. This means its internal energy decreases, so \(\Delta U\) is negative.
frontZh: 当气体向周围环境传递热量并膨胀时，ΔU 的符号是什么？
backZh: 利用热力学第一定律：\[ \Delta U = Q - W \]当气体向周围环境传递热量时，\(Q\)为负值。当它膨胀时，它确实对周围环境起作用，所以\(W\)为正。这意味着它的内能减少，所以\(\Delta U\)是负。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? If a gas is heated, it must expand.
back: False. From the first law of thermodynamics, If a gas is heated, Q is positive, but the energy may increase the system's internal energy instead of causing expansion. So W can be zero while the first law is still obeyed.

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Define the entropy of a system.
back: The entropy of a system is a measure of the number of possible arrangements of the particles and their energies, i.e. it is a measure of the disorder of the system.
frontZh: 定义系统的熵。
backZh: 系统的熵是粒子及其能量的可能排列的物理量的度量，即它是系统的无序的度量。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Put the three main states of matter in order from highest to lowest entropy.
back: The three main states of matter, in order from highest to lowest entropy, are: • Gas (highest entropy) • Liquid • Solid (lowest entropy)
frontZh: 将的三个主要物质态按熵从高到低的顺序排列。
backZh: 的三种主要物质态，按照熵从最高到最低的顺序，分别是： • 气体（最高熵） • 液体 • 固体（最低熵）

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? Entropy and temperature remain constant during a change of state.
back: False. Temperature remains constant during a change of state, but entropy changes.
frontZh: 是真是假？熵和温度在状态变化期间保持恒定。
backZh: 错误。状态变化期间温度保持恒定，但熵发生变化。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Does entropy increase or decrease during sublimation?
back: In sublimation, a solid becomes a gas so entropy increases.
frontZh: 升华过程中熵增加还是减少？
backZh: 在升华中，固体变成气体，因此熵增加。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Does entropy increase or decrease during freezing?
back: In freezing, a liquid becomes a solid so entropy decreases.
frontZh: 冷冻过程中熵增加还是减少？
backZh: 在冷冻过程中，液体变成固体，因此熵减少。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Other than changing state of matter, what are two situations in which entropy can increase?
back:
Entropy can also increase when
• A solid dissolves in a solvent
• A gas diffuses in a container
frontZh: 除了改变物质状态之外，熵可以增加的两种情况是什么？
backZh:
当以下情况时，熵也会增加：
• 固体溶解在溶剂中
• 气体在容器中扩散

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Define a reversible process.
back: A reversible process is one where there is no overall change in entropy as the system and its surroundings are returned to their original states.
frontZh: 定义可逆过程。
backZh: 可逆过程是当系统及其周围环境返回到其原始状态时，熵没有整体变化的过程。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Define an irreversible process.
back: An irreversible process is one that results in an increase in entropy as the system and its surroundings cannot return to their original states.
frontZh: 定义一个不可逆过程。
backZh: 不可逆过程是一种导致熵增加的过程，因为系统及其周围环境无法返回到其原始状态。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? Processes occurring in real isolated systems are almost always irreversible.
back: True. Processes occurring in real isolated systems are almost always irreversible. The entropy of a real isolated system always increases.
frontZh: 是真是假？真实隔离系统中发生的过程几乎总是不可逆的。
backZh: 正确。在实际隔离系统中发生的过程是几乎总是不可逆的。真实孤立系统的熵总是增加的。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Define an isolated system.
back: An isolated system is one in which neither matter nor energy can be transferred in or out.
frontZh: 定义一个隔离系统。
backZh: 孤立系统是指物质和能量都不能传入或传出的系统。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Why can the entropy of a non-isolated system decrease?
back: The entropy of a non-isolated system can decrease because this is compensated for by an equal, or greater increase in the entropy of the surroundings.
frontZh: 为什么非孤立系统的熵会减少？
backZh: 非隔离系统的熵可以减少，因为这是通过周围环境的熵的相等或更大的增加来补偿的。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What is the net change in thermal energy transferred for a reversible process?
back:
For a reversible process:

\[
dS = \frac{\delta Q_{\mathrm{rev}}}{T}
\]

so the reversible thermal energy transfer is:

\[
\delta Q_{\mathrm{rev}} = T\,dS
\]

For an isothermal reversible process, this becomes:

\[
Q_{\mathrm{rev}} = T\Delta S
\]
frontZh: 可逆过程传递的热能的净变化是多少？
backZh:
对于可逆过程：\[
dS = \frac{\delta Q_{\mathrm{rev}}}{T}
\]所以可逆热能传递为：\[
\delta Q_{\mathrm{rev}} = T\,dS
\]对于等温可逆过程，这变为：\[
Q_{\mathrm{rev}} = T\Delta S
\]

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Define the term microstate.
back: A microstate is one possible arrangement of the particles in the system.
frontZh: 定义术语微观状态。
backZh: 微观状态是系统中粒子的一种可能排列。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the second law of thermodynamics.
back: The second law of thermodynamics states that in every process, the total entropy of an isolated system always increases.
frontZh: 陈述热力学第二定律。
backZh: 这热力学第二定律指出在每个过程中，孤立系统的总熵总是增加。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the second law of thermodynamics in the Kelvin form.
back: The Kelvin form of the second law of thermodynamics states that when extracting energy from a heat reservoir, it is impossible to convert it all into work.
frontZh: 以开尔文形式陈述热力学第二定律。
backZh: 热力学第二定律的开尔文形式表明，当从热库中提取能量时，不可能将其全部转化为功。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the second law of thermodynamics in the Clausius form.
back: The Clausius form of the second law of thermodynamics states that thermal energy cannot spontaneously transfer from a region of lower temperature to a region of higher temperature.
frontZh: 以克劳修斯形式陈述热力学第二定律。
backZh: 热力学第二定律的克劳修斯形式表明热能不能自发地从较低温度区域转移到较高温度区域。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? Heat can be converted completely into work without flowing into a cold reservoir.
back: False. Heat cannot be completely converted to work, this violates the Kelvin form of the second law.
frontZh: 是真是假？热量可以完全转化为功，无需流入冷库。
backZh: 错误。热量不能完全转化为做功，这违反了开尔文形式第二定律。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? Heat cannot spontaneously flow from a cold region to a warmer region.
back: True. Heat cannot spontaneously flow from a cold region to a warmer region.
frontZh: 是真是假？热量不能自发地从寒冷地区流向温暖地区。
backZh: 真的。热不能自发地从寒冷地区流向温暖地区。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: Under what condition can heat flow from a cold region to a hot region?
back: Heat can flow from a cold region to a hot region when work is done on the system.
frontZh: 什么条件下热量可以从冷区流向热区？
backZh: 热量可以从寒冷地区流向炎热地区当系统上的工作完成时。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the condition for a process to be isovolumetric.
back: The condition for an isovolumetric process is i.e. the volume remains constant.
frontZh: 说明过程等容的条件。
backZh: 等容过程的条件是，即体积保持恒定。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the condition for a process to be isobaric.
back: The condition for an isobaric process is i.e. the pressure remains constant.
frontZh: 说明过程等压的条件。
backZh: 等压过程的条件是，即压力保持恒定。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: State the condition for a process to be isothermal.
back: The condition for an isothermal process is , i.e. the temperature remains constant.
frontZh: 说明过程等温的条件。
backZh: 等温过程的条件是 ，即温度保持恒定。

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: What are three thermodynamic processes in which entropy decreases?
back: Three thermodynamic processes in which entropy decreases are: • Isobaric compression • Isothermal compression • Isovolumetric cooling
frontZh: 熵减少的三个热力学过程是什么？
backZh: 熵减少的三个热力学过程是： • 等压压缩 • 等温压缩 • 等容冷却

front: What are the four steps of a simple heat engine?
back:
The four steps of a simple heat engine are:
• Extract heat from a hot reservoir
•  Use some of the extracted heat to perform work
• Release excess heat into a cold reservoir
• Return to initial state and repeat
frontZh: 简单热机的四个步是什么？
backZh:
简单热机的四个步骤是：
• 从热储层中提取热量
• 使用部分提取的热量来完成工作
• 将多余的热量释放到冷库中
• 返回初始状态并重复

subtopicFull: B.4 Thermodynamics: First/second laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy.
front: True or False? A thermodynamic system following a Carnot cycle is 100% efficient.
back: False. A system cannot be 100% efficient, this violates the Kelvin statement of the second law (not all heat energy in can be converted to work).
frontZh: 是真是假？卡诺循环后的热力学系统效率为 100%。
backZh: 错误。一个系统不可能100%有效，这违反了第二定律的开尔文陈述（并非所有热能都可以转化为功）。

front: What is the most efficient engine cycle theoretically possible?
back: The Carnot cycle is the most efficient engine cycle theoretically possible.

subtopicFull: B.5 – Currents And Circuits
front: The graph shows how the electric potential difference across a cell varies with the current leaving the cell. Determine the emf of the cell and its internal resistance.
back:
Rearranging the equation for emf gives the equation of a line :
\[\varepsilon = I(R + r) = IR + Ir = Ir + V\]
\[\Rightarrow V = -Ir + \varepsilon\]

So, \(-r\) is the gradient, and \(\varepsilon\) is the y-intercept.

subtopicFull: B.5 – Currents And Circuits
front: When an ideal voltmeter is directly connected across a cell , the reading of the voltmeter is always [...] the emf of the cell.
back:
When an ideal voltmeter is directly connected across a cell , the reading of the voltmeter is always equal to the emf of the cell.

An ideal voltemeter has infinite resistance , so there should be a current of 0, thus \(V = \varepsilon\).

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define electric current.
back: Electric current is the rate of flow of charge carriers. Useful formula — Current: \[ I = \frac{\Delta Q}{\Delta t} \]
frontZh: 定义电流。
backZh: 电流为电荷载流子的流速。 有用的公式 — 当前：\[ I = \frac{\Delta Q}{\Delta t} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What are the charged particles that flow in electrical circuits?
back: The charged particles that flow in electrical circuits are electrons.
frontZh: 在电路中流动的带电粒子是什么？
backZh: 在电路中流动的带电粒子是电子。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define conventional current.
back: Conventional current is the flow of positive charge from the positive terminal of a cell to the negative terminal.
frontZh: 定义常规电流。
backZh: 常规电流是正电荷从电池的正极端子流向负极端子。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define direct current.
back: Direct current (d.c.) flows around a circuit in one direction.
frontZh: 定义直流。
backZh: 直流电 (d.c.) 在电路中沿一个方向流动。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State the equation for current as the flow of charge.
back: The equation for current as the flow of charge is: \[ I = \frac{\Delta q}{\Delta t} \] Where: • I = current, measured in amps (A) • Δq = change in charge, measured in coulombs (C) • Δt = change in time, measured in seconds (s)
frontZh: 将电流方程表述为电荷流。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Electrons flow around a circuit towards the positive terminal, but conventional current flows around a circuit towards the negative terminal.
back: True. Electrons do flow around a circuit towards the positive terminal, while conventional current flows towards the negative terminal. It is electrons that actually form the current, but the idea of conventional current was in use before the electron was discovered.
frontZh: 是真是假？电子围绕电路流向正极端子，但传统电流围绕电路流向负极端子。
backZh: 正确。电子或围绕电路流向正极端子，而传统电流流向负极端子。实际上是电子形成了电流，但传统电流的概念在电子被发现之前就已被使用。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define electric potential difference.
back: Electric potential difference is the work done per unit charge on moving a positive charge between two points along the path of the current. Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]
frontZh: 定义电势差。
backZh: 电势差是每单位电荷在沿电流路径的两点之间移动正电荷时所做的功。 有用的公式 - 电势差：\[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

back: The equation linking potential difference, work done and charge is Where: • V = potential difference, measured in volts (V) • W = work done, measured in joules (J) • q = charge, measured in coulombs (C) Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? One volt is equal to one joule per coulomb.
back: True. One volt is equal to one joule per coulomb, 1 V = 1 J C−1. Useful formula — Coulomb’s law: \[ F = k\frac{q_1q_2}{r^2} \]

backZh: 正确。一伏特等于一焦耳每库仑，1 V = 1 J C−1。 有用的公式——库仑定律：\[ F = k\frac{q_1q_2}{r^2} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? A cell or battery provides the source of potential difference in an a.c. circuit.
back: False. A cell or battery provides the source of potential difference in a d.c. circuit. Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]
frontZh: 是真是假？电池或电池组提供了交流电中的电势差源。电路。
backZh: 错误。电池或电池组提供直流电中的电势差源。电路。 有用的公式 - 电势差：\[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Electrons are stored in the cell and flow through the wires when the circuit is closed.
back: False. The electrons in the circuit are the delocalised electrons in the metal of the wires and components. They flow around the closed circuit when a potential difference is applied.
frontZh: 是真是假？电子存储在电池中，并在电路闭合时流经电线。
backZh: 错误。电路中的电子是电线和元件金属中的离域电子。当施加电势差时，它们在闭合电路周围流动。

front: Define the electronvolt.
back: The electronvolt is the amount of energy needed to move an electron through a potential difference of one volt.
frontZh: 定义电子伏。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is an electrical conductor?
back: An electrical conductor is a material that allows charge (usually electrons) to flow through it easily.
frontZh: 什么是电导体？
backZh: 电导体是一种允许电荷（通常是电子）轻松流过的材料。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Give one example of an electrical conductor.
back: Examples of electrical conductors are: copper; silver; aluminium; steel; gold
frontZh: 给出一个电导体的例子。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Why are metals good electrical conductors?
back: Metals are good electrical conductors because metals have delocalised electrons that flow when a potential difference is applied.
frontZh: 为什么金属是良好的电导体？
backZh: 金属是良好的电导体，因为金属具有离域电子，当施加电势差时，这些电子会流动。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is an electrical insulator?
back: An electrical insulator is a material that has no delocalised electrons, so it does not allow charge to flow easily.
frontZh: 什么是电绝缘体？
backZh: 电绝缘体是一种没有离域电子的材料，因此它不允许电荷轻易流动。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Give one example of an electrical insulator.
back: Examples of electrical insulators are: rubber; plastic; glass; wood
frontZh: 给出一个电绝缘体的例子。
backZh: 电绝缘体的例子有： 橡胶；塑料;玻璃;木头

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is static electricity?
back: Static electricity occurs when charge builds up on the surface of an insulator and is discharged when brought into contact with a conductor.
frontZh: 什么是静电？
backZh: 当电荷在绝缘体表面积聚并在与导体接触时释放时，就会产生静电。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define an ideal ammeter.
back: An ideal ammeter has zero resistance, such that all the current passes through it.
frontZh: 定义一个理想电流表。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define an ideal voltmeter.
back: An ideal voltmeter has infinite resistance, such that no current passes through it.
frontZh: 定义一个理想电压表。
backZh: 理想电压表具有无限电阻，因此没有电流通过它。

front: Define the resistance of a component.
back: The resistance of a component is the ratio of the potential difference across the component to the current flowing through it.

front: True or False? The greater the resistance of a component, the higher the current flowing through it.
back: False. The greater the resistance of a component, the lower the current flowing through it.

front: State the SI base units for 1 Ω.
back: The SI base units for 1 Ω are kg m−2 s−3 A−2.
frontZh: 注明 1 Ω 的 SI 基本单位。
backZh: 1 Ω 的 SI 基本单位为kg m−2s−3A−2。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? For resistance calculations, mA and kV must be converted into A and V.
back: True. For resistance calculations, mA and kV must be converted into A and V.
frontZh: 是真是假？对于电阻计算，mA 和 kV 必须转换为 A 和 V。
backZh: 正确。对于电阻计算，mA 和 kV 必须转换为 A 和 V。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Resistance is caused by collisions between flowing electrons and the metal ions in the conductor.
back: True. Resistance is caused by collisions between flowing electrons and the metal ions in the conductor.
frontZh: 是真是假？电阻是由流动的电子与导体中的金属离子之间的碰撞引起的。
backZh: 正确。电阻是由流动的电子与导体中的金属离子之间的碰撞引起的。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State the factors affecting resistance.
back: The factors affecting resistance are: material; length; cross-sectional area; temperature
frontZh: 说出影响电阻的因素。
backZh: 影响电阻的因素有：材质；长度;横截面积；温度

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? The resistance of a wire is directly proportional to its length.
back: True. The resistance of a wire is directly proportional to its length.
frontZh: 是真是假？电线的电阻与其长度成正比。
backZh: 正确。电线的电阻与其长度成正比。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? The resistance of a wire is directly proportional to its cross-sectional area.
back: False. The resistance of a wire is inversely proportional to its cross-sectional area.
frontZh: 是真是假？导线的电阻与其横截面积成正比。
backZh: 错误。导线的电阻为与其横截面积成反比。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define resistivity.
back:
Resistivity, \(\rho\), is a property of a material that measures how strongly the material opposes electric current.

It is defined by:

\[
\rho = \frac{RA}{L}
\]

where \(R\) is resistance, \(A\) is cross-sectional area, and \(L\) is length.

Equivalently:

\[
R = \rho \frac{L}{A}
\]

A material with a larger \(\rho\) gives a larger resistance for the same length and area.
frontZh: 定义电阻率。
backZh:
电阻率\(\rho\)是材料的一种属性，用于测量材料抵抗电流的强度。

它的定义为：\[
\rho = \frac{RA}{L}
\]其中\(R\)是电阻，\(A\)是横截面积，\(L\)是长度。

等效地：\[
R = \rho \frac{L}{A}
\]对于相同的长度和面积，具有较大\(\rho\)的材料可提供更大的电阻。

backZh: 电阻率方程为 其中：ρ= 电阻率，单位为Ω米（Ω·m）；R= 电阻，单位为欧姆 (Ω)；A= 横截面积，以米平方为单位测量 (m2)；L= 长度，单位为米 (m)

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Do metals have high or low values of resistivity?
back: Metals have low values of resistivity, and insulators have high values.
frontZh: 金属的电阻率是高还是低？
backZh: 金属具有低电阻率值，绝缘体具有高值。

front: True or False? As the current through a filament lamp increases, the resistance decreases.
back: False. As the current through a filament lamp increases, the resistance increases.
frontZh: 是真是假？随着通过白炽灯的电流增加，电阻减小。
backZh: 错误。随着通过白炽灯的电流增加，电阻增加。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Why does the resistance of a filament lamp change when the voltage is changed?
back: The resistance of a filament lamp increases as the voltage is increased because as the voltage increases, current increases, and the lamp heats up; as the temperature increases, metal ions in the filament wire vibrate more; the number of collisions between the ions and free electrons increases
frontZh: 为什么白炽灯的电阻随电压变化而变化？
backZh: 白炽灯的电阻随着电压的增加而增加，因为随着电压的增加，电流增加，灯管发热；随着温度的升高，灯丝中的金属离子振动更大；离子和自由电子之间的碰撞次数增加

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What are the main features of an I-V graph for a diode?
back: The I-V graph for a diode shows they have • a high resistance when the current flows in one direction • a low resistance when the current flows in the opposite direction
frontZh: 二极管的 I-V 图的主要特征是什么？
backZh: 二极管的 I-V 图显示它们具有•当电流单向流动时电阻较高•a当电流反方向流动时电阻较低

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Current is different at different points in a series circuit.
back: False. Current is the same everywhere in a series circuit.
frontZh: 是真是假？串联电路中不同点的电流是不同的。
backZh: 错误。系列电路中到处都是相同的。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? In a parallel circuit, the current from the power source is larger than the current in each branch.
back: True. In a parallel circuit, the current from the power source is larger than the current in each branch.
frontZh: 是真是假？在并联电路中，来自电源的电流大于各支路的电流。
backZh: 正确。在并联电路中，来自电源的电流大于各支路的电流。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? The amount of current flowing in a series circuit depends on the potential difference and resistance in the circuit.
back: True. The amount of current flowing in any circuit depends on the potential difference and resistance in the circuit. Ohm's law: \[ V = IR \]
frontZh: 是真是假？串联电路中流动的电流量取决于电路中的电势差和电阻。
backZh: 真的。流入的电流量任何电路取决于电路中的电势差和电阻。 欧姆定律：\[ V = IR \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Current is conserved at a junction in a parallel circuit.
back: True. Current is conserved at a junction in a parallel circuit because charge is always conserved.
frontZh: 是真是假？电流在并联电路的结点处守恒。
backZh: 正确。并联电路中的结点处的电流守恒，因为电荷始终守恒。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Current always splits equally at a junction in a parallel circuit.
back: False. Current will only split equally at a junction if the resistance in each branch is equal.
frontZh: 是真是假？电流总是在并联电路的结点处均分。
backZh: 错误。如果每个支路中的电阻相等，则电流只会在结点处均分。

back: False. When several cells are connected in series, the potential difference across them all is the sum of the separate potential differences. Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

backZh: 系列电路中组件之间的总电势差等于每个组件之间各个电势差的总和。 这可以用数学表达为： 有用的公式 - 电势差：\[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is the rule for determining the total potential difference in a parallel circuit?
back: The total potential difference across an arrangement of parallel resistances is the same as the potential difference across one branch in the arrangement of the parallel resistances. This can be expressed mathematically as: \[ V_\mathrm{total} = V_1 = V_2 = V_3 = \cdots \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? The combined resistance of two resistors in parallel is less than that of either resistor by itself.
back: True. The combined resistance of two resistors in parallel is less than that of either resistor by itself.
frontZh: 是真是假？两个并联电阻器的组合电阻小于任一电阻器单独的电阻值。
backZh: 正确。两个电阻并联的组合电阻小于任一电阻单独的电阻值。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: If the potential difference of the power source remains constant, but more components are added to a circuit, what effect does this have on the current?
back: Adding components to a circuit increases the total resistance of the circuit, so the current would decrease (for a constant potential difference). Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]
frontZh: 如果电源的电势差保持恒定，但在电路中添加更多元件，这对电流有何影响？
backZh: 在电路中添加组件会增加电路的总电阻，因此电流会减少（对于恒定电势差）。 有用的公式 - 电势差：\[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: If the potential difference of the power source is increased, but everything else in the circuit remains constant, what effect does this have on the current?
back: If the potential difference of the power source is increased, but everything else in the circuit remains constant, the current will increase. Useful formula — Potential difference: \[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]
frontZh: 如果电源的电势差增加，但电路中的其他一切保持不变，这对电流有什么影响？
backZh: 如果电源的电势差增加，但电路中的其他一切保持不变，则电流将增加。 有用的公式 - 电势差：\[ V = \frac{W}{q} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define electrical power.
back: Electrical power is the rate at which energy is transferred or dissipated by a resistor. Useful formula — Electrical power: \[ P = VI = I^2R = \frac{V^2}{R} \]
frontZh: 定义电功率。
backZh: 电功率是速率，在该速率下，电阻器传输或耗散能量。 有用的公式 - 电功率：\[ P = VI = I^2R = \frac{V^2}{R} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? Work is done when energy is transferred by moving charges in a circuit.
back: True. Work is done when energy is transferred by moving charges in a circuit. \[ V = \frac{W}{Q} \] \[ I = \frac{Q}{t} \]
frontZh: 是真是假？当能量通过电路中的移动电荷转移时，就完成了工作。
backZh: 真的。工作完成时能量被转移经过搬家费在一个电路中。\[ V = \frac{W}{Q} \] \[ I = \frac{Q}{t} \]

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How are chemical cells used as an energy source in circuits?
back: Chemical cells use the energy stored in chemicals to arrange charges in a way that produces a potential difference.
frontZh: 化学电池如何用作电路中的能源？
backZh: 化学电池使用化学物质中存储的能量以产生电势差的方式排列电荷。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How are solar cells used as an energy source in circuits?
back: Solar cells use the radiant energy from the Sun to produce a potential difference.
frontZh: 太阳能电池如何用作电路中的能源？
backZh: 太阳能电池利用太阳的辐射能产生电势差。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How are electrical generators used as a source of electrical energy?
back: Electrical generators use the energy from burning fuels to convert kinetic energy into electric potential energy to produce a potential difference.
frontZh: 发电机如何用作电能来源？
backZh: 发电机利用燃料燃烧产生的能量将动能转换为电势能，从而产生电势差。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How are wind generators used as a source of electrical energy?
back: Wind generators use the energy from moving air to convert the kinetic energy of wind into electric potential energy to produce a potential difference.
frontZh: 风力发电机如何用作电能来源？
backZh: 风力发电机利用流动空气的能量，将风的动能转化为电势能，产生电势差。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of single-use alkaline batteries.
back: Advantages of single-use alkaline batteries are: the chemicals used have a high energy density; they are a convenient source of energy used in everyday appliances; they are a portable source of electrical energy; several batteries can be combined in series to increase p.d.; they are very inexpensive
frontZh: 说明和两种一次性碱性电池的优点。
backZh: 一次性碱性电池的优点是：所用化学物质能量密度高；它们是日常电器中使用的便捷能源；它们是便携式电源；可以将多个电池串联起来以增加 p.d.；它们非常便宜

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of single-use alkaline batteries.
back: Disadvantages of single-use alkaline batteries are: they are non-rechargeable and need to be replaced often; they have a high internal resistance; they contribute to pollution when disposed; they are made from non-renewable materials
frontZh: 说明和两种一次性碱性电池的缺点。
backZh: 一次性碱性电池的缺点是：不可充电，需要经常更换；它们具有较高的内阻；它们在处置时会造成污染；它们由不可再生材料制成

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of lithium-ion batteries.
back: Advantages of lithium-ion batteries are: they have a very high energy density; they have a high electrical efficiency; they are a convenient source of energy used in everyday appliances (e.g. laptops, phones); they are rechargeable and have a long lifetime; they have a fast charging time; they are a portable source of electrical energy; they have a low internal resistance
frontZh: 陈述和两种锂离子电池的优点。
backZh: 锂离子电池的优点是：能量密度非常高；它们具有高电效率；它们是日常电器（例如笔记本电脑、电话）中使用的便捷能源；它们可充电且使用寿命长；充电速度快；它们是便携式电源；它们的内阻较低

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of lithium-ion batteries.
back: Disadvantages of lithium-ion batteries are: • the charge capacity of the cell degrades over time • the internal resistance increases over time • they are expensive compared to other types of battery
frontZh: 陈述和两种锂离子电池的缺点。
backZh: 锂离子电池的缺点是：•电池的充电容量会随着时间的推移而降低•内阻随时间增加•与其他类型的电池相比，它们价格昂贵

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of lead-acid batteries.
back: Advantages of lead-acid batteries are: • they are relatively cheap • they are rechargeable • they are able to deliver very high currents in a short time which is useful for starting up vehicles
frontZh: 陈述和两种铅酸蓄电池的优点。
backZh: 铅酸蓄电池的优点是：•它们相对便宜•可充电•它们能够在短时间内提供非常高的电流，这对于启动车辆非常有用

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of lead-acid batteries.
back: Disadvantages of lead-acid batteries are: they have a low energy density; the internal resistance increases as the battery degrades over time; they have a limited number of full discharge cycles; they contribute to pollution when disposed as they contain toxic and corrosive materials; they are made from non-renewable materials
frontZh: 说明和两种铅酸蓄电池的缺点。
backZh: 铅酸电池的缺点是：能量密度低；内阻随着电池随时间的推移而退化而增加；它们的完全放电循环次数有限；它们在处置时会造成污染，因为它们含有有毒和腐蚀性物质；它们由不可再生材料制成

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of photovoltaic cells.
back: Advantages of photovoltaic cells are: they provide a virtually unlimited supply of energy; they are a clean energy supply and do not contribute to pollution; the energy source (the Sun) is freely available everywhere; they are cheap to maintain; no input of fuel is required
frontZh: 陈述两种光伏电池的优点。
backZh: 光伏电池的优点是：它们提供几乎无限的能量供应；它们是清洁能源，不会造成污染；能源（太阳）随处可见；它们的维护成本低廉；无需输入燃料

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of photovoltaic cells.
back: Disadvantages of photovoltaic cells are: the output can be variable due to dependence on weather conditions; energy output can be significantly impacted by poor weather; they have a low efficiency; they can only generate energy during daylight hours; each cell only produces a small amount of electricity; solar farms are required for large scale electricity production
frontZh: 陈述两种光伏电池的缺点。
backZh: 光伏电池的缺点是：输出可能因天气条件而变化；能源输出可能会受到恶劣天气的严重影响；他们的效率低；它们只能在白天产生能量；每个电池仅产生少量电力；大规模发电需要太阳能发电场

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of wind generators.
back: Advantages of wind generators are: they provide a virtually unlimited supply of energy; they are a clean energy supply and do not contribute to pollution; the energy source (the wind) is freely available everywhere; they are cheap to maintain; no input of fuel is required
frontZh: 阐述两种风力发电机的优点。
backZh: 风力发电机的优点是：它们提供几乎无限的能源供应；它们是清洁能源，不会造成污染；能源（风）随处可见；它们的维护成本低廉；无需输入燃料

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of wind generators.
back: Disadvantages of wind generators are: the output can be variable due to dependence on weather conditions; energy output can be significantly impacted by lack of wind; they have a low efficiency; they contribute to noise and visual pollution
frontZh: 述明和两种风力发电机的缺点。
backZh: 风力发电机的缺点是：输出可能因天气条件而变化；缺乏风能会严重影响能源输出；他们的效率低；它们会造成噪音和视觉污染

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two advantages of fossil fuel generators.
back: Advantages of fossil fuel generators are: there is already an extensive infrastructure in place; the fuels used have a high energy density; they are highly reliable and provide energy consistently; they are a well-known and developed technology
frontZh: 国家两台化石燃料发电机的优点。
backZh: 化石燃料发电机的优点是： 已经拥有广泛的基础设施；使用的燃料具有高能量密度；它们高度可靠并持续提供能源；它们是众所周知且发达的技术

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: State two disadvantages of fossil fuel generators.
back: Disadvantages of fossil fuel generators are: they produce significant greenhouse gas emissions which contribute to global warming; they produce other polluting gases which contribute to acid rain and other environmental issues; fossil fuels are a non-renewable energy source
frontZh: 说明和两种化石燃料发电机的缺点。
backZh: 化石燃料发电机的缺点是：它们会产生大量温室气体排放，导致全球变暖；它们产生其他污染气体，导致酸雨和其他环境问题；化石燃料是不可再生能源

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define electromotive force (emf).
back: Electromotive force (emf) is the total energy transferred in a source of electrical energy per unit charge passing through it.
frontZh: 定义电动势（emf）。
backZh: 电动势 (emf) 是通过电源的每单位电荷在电源中传输的总能量。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define internal resistance.
back: Internal resistance is the resistance of a source of electrical energy, such as batteries, as they are not perfect conductors.
frontZh: 定义内阻。
backZh: 内阻是电源（例如电池）的电阻，因为它们不是完美的导体。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: Define terminal potential difference.
back:
Terminal potential difference is the potential difference across the terminals of a source of electrical energy when it is supplying a current to a circuit.

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What are ' lost volts '?
back: 'Lost volts' refer to the voltage drop, or decrease in potential difference, that occurs when a source of electrical energy supplies a current to a circuit.
frontZh: 什么是“失伏”？
backZh: “电压损失”是指电源向电路提供电流时发生的电压降，或电势差减少。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? When the internal resistance is zero, the terminal p.d. of a cell is less than its emf.
back: False. When the internal resistance is zero, the terminal p.d. of a cell is equal to its emf. This is when no current flows.
frontZh: 是真是假？当内阻为零时，端子p.d.电池的电动势小于其电动势。
backZh: 错误。当内阻为零时，端子p.d.电池的等于与其电动势。这是没有电流流动的时候。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: True or False? When a current flows, the terminal p.d. of a cell will be less than its emf.
back: True. When a current flows, the terminal p.d. of a cell will be less than its emf. This is because there will be a potential drop across the internal resistance.
frontZh: 是真是假？当电流流动时，端子 p.d.电池的电动势将小于其电动势。
backZh: 正确。当电流流动时，端子 p.d.电池的小于其电动势。这是因为内阻可能会下降。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is a thermistor?
back: A thermistor is a temperature-dependent resistor. This means its resistance changes depending on its temperature.
frontZh: 什么是热敏电阻？
backZh: 热敏电阻是与温度相关的电阻器。 这意味着其电阻根据其温度而变化。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How does the resistance of a thermistor change when its temperature is increased?
back: When the temperature of a thermistor is increased, its resistance decreases.
frontZh: 当温度升高时，热敏电阻的阻值如何变化？
backZh: 当热敏电阻的温度升高时，其电阻减小。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is an LDR?
back: LDR stands for light-dependent resistor. This means its resistance changes depending on the intensity of light on it.
frontZh: 什么是LDR？
backZh: LDR代表光敏电阻。 这意味着它的电阻根据其上的光强度而改变。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: How does the resistance of an LDR change when the intensity of light on it is increased?
back: When light intensity on an LDR is increased, its resistance decreases. (Remember: L ight D ecreases R esistance - LDR)
frontZh: 当光照强度增加时，LDR的电阻如何变化？
backZh: 当 LDR 上的光强度增加时，其电阻减小。 （记住：LightD增加R电阻 - LDR）

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is a variable resistor?
back: A variable resistor is a resistor that can change the resistance by changing the length of the wire that makes up the circuit. This is because a longer length of wire has more resistance than a shorter length of wire. Its circuit symbol is a resistor with a diagonal arrow through it.
frontZh: 什么是可变电阻器？
backZh: 可变电阻器是可以通过改变构成电路的导线长度来改变阻值的电阻器。 这是因为较长的电线比较短的电线具有更大的电阻。 其电路符号是一个带有对角箭头的电阻器。

subtopicFull: B.5 Current and Circuits: Resistance, Ohm’s law, series/parallel circuits.
front: What is a potentiometer?
back: A potentiometer is a type of variable resistor that uses a sliding contact to vary the potential difference in a circuit.
frontZh: 什么是电位器？
backZh: 电位器是一种可变电阻器，它使用滑动触点来改变电路中的电势差。

front: What is an oscillation?
back: An oscillation is the repetitive variation with time of the displacement of an object about the equilibrium position
frontZh: 什么是振荡？
backZh: 振荡是物体围绕平衡位置的位移随时间的重复变化

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: Define the term equilibrium position in simple harmonic motion.
back: The term equilibrium position in simple harmonic motion is the position where there is no resultant force acting on an object.
frontZh: 定义简谐振动中的术语平衡位置。
backZh: 简谐振动中的平衡位置是指没有合力作用在物体上的位置。

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: What does displacement mean in oscillations?
back: Displacement in oscillations is the horizontal or vertical distance of a point on the wave from its equilibrium position.
frontZh: 振动中的位移意味着什么？
backZh: 振荡位移是波上一点距其平衡位置的水平或垂直距离。

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: True or False? The period of an oscillation is measured in seconds.
back: True. The period of an oscillation is measured in seconds (s).
frontZh: 是真是假？振荡周期以秒为单位测量。
backZh: 正确。振荡周期以秒 (s) 为单位测量。

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: What is the amplitude of an oscillation?
back: The amplitude of an oscillation is the maximum value of the displacement on either side of the equilibrium position.

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: What is simple harmonic motion (SHM)?
back:
Simple harmonic motion is oscillatory motion in which the acceleration is directly proportional to the displacement from equilibrium and is always directed towards the equilibrium position.

The defining equation is:

\[
a = -\omega^2 x
\]

The negative sign means the acceleration is a restoring acceleration: when the object is displaced one way, the acceleration points back towards the centre.

The motion is periodic, and for ideal SHM the displacement-time graph is sinusoidal.
frontZh: 什么是简谐振动（SHM）？
backZh:
简谐振动是振荡运动，其中加速度与平衡位置的位移成正比，并且始终指向平衡位置。

定义方程为：\[
a = -\omega^2 x
\]负号表示加速度是恢复加速度：当物体单向位移时，加速度指向回中心。

运动是周期性的，对于理想的 SHM，位移-时间图是正弦曲线。

subtopicFull: C.1 Simple Harmonic Motion: Oscillations, pendulums, graphs.
front: What is simple harmonic motion (SHM)?
back:
Simple harmonic motion is oscillatory motion in which the acceleration is directly proportional to the displacement from equilibrium and is always directed towards the equilibrium position.

The defining equation is:

\[
a = -\omega^2 x
\]

The negative sign means the acceleration is a restoring acceleration: when the object is displaced one way, the acceleration points back towards the centre.

The motion is periodic, and for ideal SHM the displacement-time graph is sinusoidal.
frontZh: 什么是简谐振动（SHM）？
backZh:
简谐振动是振荡运动，其中加速度与平衡位置的位移成正比，并且始终指向平衡位置。

定义方程为：\[
a = -\omega^2 x
\]负号表示加速度是恢复加速度：当物体单向位移时，加速度指向回中心。

运动是周期性的，对于理想的 SHM，位移-时间图是正弦曲线。

frontZh: 是真是假？在SHM中，每次完整振动的时间间隔是相同的。
backZh: 正确。在 SHM 中，每次完整振动的时间间隔（称为周期）是恒定的。

subtopicFull: C.2 – Wave Model
front: Explain the equation: \(v = f\lambda = \frac{\lambda}{T}\)
back:
This is the approximate Doppler shift equation for electromagnetic waves when the source and observer are moving slowly compared with the speed of light. \[ \frac{\Delta f}{f} = \frac{\Delta \lambda}{\lambda} \approx \frac{v}{c} \] It says the fractional change in frequency or wavelength is approximately equal to the relative line-of-sight speed divided by the speed of light. Meaning of each symbol:
\(\Delta f\) = change in observed frequency
\(f\) = emitted frequency
\(\Delta \lambda\) = change in observed wavelength
\(\lambda\) = emitted wavelength
\(v\) = relative speed along the line of sight
\(c\) = speed of light For a source moving away, wavelength increases and frequency decreases. For a source moving towards the observer, wavelength decreases and frequency increases. The equation is usually used with magnitudes; the sign depends on whether the source is approaching or receding.

source.deck: Physics::C - Wave behaviour::C.2 - Wave model

backRawHtml:
\(v\) wave speed
\(f\) frequency
\(\lambda\) wavelength
\(T\) period

backZh:
这是当源和观察者以与光速相比缓慢移动时电磁波的近似多普勒频移方程。\[ \frac{\Delta f}{f} = \frac{\Delta \lambda}{\lambda} \approx \frac{v}{c} \]它表示频率或波长的分数变化大约等于相对视线速度除以光速。各符号含义：
\(\Delta f\)= 观察到的频率变化
\(f\)= 发射频率
\(\Delta \lambda\)= 观测波长的变化
\(\lambda\)= 发射波长
\(v\)= 沿视线的相对速度
\(c\)= 光速 对于远离的源，波长增加而频率减小。对于朝向观察者移动的光源，波长减小而频率增加。该方程通常与幅度一起使用；该符号取决于源是接近还是后退。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? The unit hertz is equivalent to per second.
back: True. The unit hertz (Hz) is equivalent to per second (s−1).
frontZh: 是真是假？单位赫兹相当于每秒。
backZh: 正确。单位赫兹 (Hz) 相当于每秒 (s-1)。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? As wavelength increases, frequency decreases for a wave at a constant speed.
back: True. As wavelength increases, frequency decreases for a wave at a constant speed.
frontZh: 是真是假？当波以恒定速度增加时，频率会降低。
backZh: 正确。当波以恒定速度增加时，频率会降低。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Define a transverse wave.
back: A wave is transverse if the oscillations are perpendicular to the direction of wave motion and energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义横波。
backZh: 如果振荡是垂直于波运动和能量传递的方向，则波是横向。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Define a longitudinal wave.
back: A wave is longitudinal if the oscillations are parallel to the direction of wave motion and energy transfer.
frontZh: 定义纵波。
backZh: 如果振荡是平行于波运动和能量传递的方向，则波是纵向。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Longitudinal waves can travel through a vacuum, while transverse waves cannot.
back: False. Transverse waves can travel through a vacuum, while longitudinal waves cannot.
frontZh: 是真是假？纵波可以在真空中传播，而横波则不能。
backZh: 错误。横波可以穿过真空，而纵波则不能。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Define a rarefaction.
back: A rarefaction is an area of low pressure in a longitudinal wave, where the particles are further apart from each other.
frontZh: 定义稀疏。
backZh: 稀疏是纵波中的低压区域，其中粒子彼此距离更远。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Define a compression.
back: A compression is an area of high pressure in a longitudinal wave, where the particles are closer together.
frontZh: 定义压缩。
backZh: 压缩是纵向波中的高压区域，其中粒子更靠近。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Give an example of a transverse wave.
back: Examples of transverse waves are: electromagnetic waves; surface water waves; vibrations on a guitar string; seismic S-waves (secondary waves)
frontZh: 举一个横波的例子。
backZh: 横波的例子有： 电磁波；表面水波；吉他弦上的振动；地震 S 波（二次波）

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Give an example of a longitudinal wave.
back: Examples of longitudinal waves are: sound waves; ultrasound; seismic P-waves (primary waves); tsunami wave
frontZh: 举一个纵波的例子。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Soundwaves are transverse waves and need a medium in which to propagate.
back: False. Soundwaves are longitudinal waves, but they do need a medium in which to propagate.
frontZh: 是真是假？声波是横波，需要介质来传播。
backZh: 错误。声波是纵波，但是它们需要介质来传播。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Infrasound waves are waves with frequencies above the range of human hearing.
back: False. Infrasound waves are waves with frequencies below the range of human hearing.
frontZh: 是真是假？次声波是频率高于人类听觉范围的波。
backZh: 错误。次声波是频率低于人类听觉范围的波。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: State the frequency range of human hearing.
back: The frequency range of human hearing is 20 Hz to 20 000 Hz.
frontZh: 说出人类听觉的频率范围。
backZh: 人类听觉的频率范围为20 Hz至20 000 Hz。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Define ultrasound.
back: Ultrasound waves are waves with frequencies above the range of human hearing, >20 kHz.
frontZh: 定义超声。
backZh: 超声波波是频率高于人类听觉范围（>20 kHz）的波。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Sound waves with higher frequencies have a higher pitch.
back: True. Sound waves with higher frequencies have a higher pitch.
frontZh: 是真是假？频率较高的声波音调较高。
backZh: 正确。具有较高频率的声波具有较高的音调。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Sound waves with larger amplitudes have a lower volume.
back: False. Sound waves with larger amplitudes have a greater volume.
frontZh: 是真是假？振幅较大的声波的音量较小。
backZh: 错误。具有较大振幅的声波具有较大音量。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? The temperature of the air affects the speed of sound travelling through it.
back: True. The temperature of the air affects the speed of sound travelling through it. The higher the temperature of the air, the faster sound can travel.
frontZh: 是真是假？空气温度影响声音在空气中传播的速度。
backZh: 正确。空气温度影响声音在空气中传播的速度。 空气温度越高，声音传播的速度越快。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Sound travels faster in gases than in solids.
back: False. Sound travels faster in solids than in gases. This is because the particles in a solid are closer together, so they can transfer energy through oscillations more quickly than in a gas.
frontZh: 是真是假？声音在气体中的传播速度比在固体中的传播速度快。
backZh: 错误的。声音传播快点在固体中比在气体中。 这是因为固体中的粒子距离更近，因此它们可以比气体中更快地通过振荡传递能量。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: How is an electromagnetic wave generated?
back: An electromagnetic wave is generated by the combined oscillation of an electric and a magnetic field.
frontZh: 电磁波是如何产生的？
backZh: 电磁波是由电场和磁场的组合振荡产生的。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? In an electromagnetic wave, the electric and magnetic fields oscillate parallel to each other.
back: False. In an electromagnetic wave, the electric and magnetic fields oscillate perpendicularly to each other.
frontZh: 是真是假？在电磁波中，电场和磁场彼此平行振荡。
backZh: 错误。在电磁波中，电场和磁场以彼此垂直的方式振荡。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: True or False? Electromagnetic waves can travel through a vacuum.
back: True. Electromagnetic waves can travel through a vacuum.
frontZh: 是真是假？电磁波可以在真空中传播。
backZh: 正确。电磁波可以在真空中传播。

back:

.
All electromagnetic waves travel at this speed.

。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Which type of electromagnetic radiation has the lowest energy?
back: The type of electromagnetic radiation with the lowest energy is radio waves. This is because the lower the frequency of the EM wave, the less energy it transfers. Radio waves have the lowest frequency and therefore the lowest energy.
frontZh: 哪种类型的电磁辐射具有最低活力？
backZh: 能量最低的电磁辐射类型是无线电波。 这是因为电磁波的频率越低，传递的能量就越少。无线电波具有最低频率，因此能量最低。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Which electromagnetic waves have a shorter wavelength than ultraviolet waves?
back: The electromagnetic waves with a shorter wavelength than ultraviolet are: • x-rays • gamma rays

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: Which part of the visible spectrum has wavelengths in the region of 700 nm?

backZh: 可见光谱中波长在 700 nm 范围内的部分是红光。

subtopicFull: C.2 Wave Model: Wave characteristics, speed, types.
front: What is the range of wavelengths that human eyes can detect?
back: The range of wavelengths that human eyes can detect is called the visible spectrum. The visible spectrum has wavelengths between 400 nm and 700 nm.
frontZh: 人眼可以检测到的波长范围是多少？
backZh: 人眼可以探测到的波长范围称为可见光谱。可见光谱的波长介于400 nm和700 nm之间。

back: Mechanical waves require a medium, and can be either transverse or longitudinal.

subtopicFull: C.3 – Wave Phenomena
front: Explain the equation: \(\text{path difference} = n\lambda\)
back:
This equation describes the activity of a radioactive sample. Meaning of each symbol:
\(A\) is the activity, the number of decays per second. Its unit is the becquerel, \(\mathrm{Bq}\).
\(\lambda\) is the decay constant. It represents the probability per unit time that one unstable nucleus will decay.
\(N\) is the number of undecayed radioactive nuclei remaining at time \(t\).
\(N_0\) is the original number of radioactive nuclei when \(t=0\). The equation says that activity is proportional to the number of undecayed nuclei remaining. As time passes, \(N\) decreases exponentially, so the activity \(A\) also decreases exponentially.

constructive inteference
\(n\) integer (0, 1, 2, 3, ...)
\(\lambda\) wavelength

\(\lambda\)是衰减常数。它表示单位时间内一个不稳定原子核衰变的概率。

\(N_0\)是\(t=0\)时的原始放射性核数。 该方程表明，活性与剩余的未衰变原子核的物理量成正比。随着时间的推移，\(N\)呈指数下降，因此\(A\)的活性也呈指数下降。

\(A\) is the activity, the number of decays per second. Its unit is the becquerel, \(\mathrm{Bq}\).
\(\lambda\) is the decay constant. It represents the probability per unit time that one unstable nucleus will decay.
\(N\) is the number of undecayed radioactive nuclei remaining at time \(t\).
\(N_0\) is the original number of radioactive nuclei when \(t=0\). The equation says that activity is proportional to the number of undecayed nuclei remaining. As time passes, \(N\) decreases exponentially, so the activity \(A\) also decreases exponentially.

This formula gives the approximate diffraction angle for a single slit:

Components:
\(\theta\) is the diffraction angle, measured in radians.
\(\lambda\) is the wavelength of the wave.
\(b\) is the slit width or aperture size.
A larger wavelength or a smaller slit width gives a larger diffraction angle.
